title.zh: 卷十六 本紀第十六: 穆宗
title.raw: 卷十六 本紀第十六: 穆宗 Volume 16 Annals 16: Muzong

meta.sourceNote: Body replaced from Wikisource raw text after ChineseNotes scrape due to glyph/encoding artifacts.

sentences.zh: 穆宗睿聖文惠孝皇帝諱恆，憲宗第三子，母曰懿安皇后郭氏。

translations.literal: Emperor Muzong, posthumous title Ruisheng Wenhuixiao, taboo name Heng, was Xianzong's third son; his mother was Empress Dowager Guo of Yi'an.
translations.idiomatic: Muzong—taboo Heng—was Xianzong's third son, born of Empress Dowager Guo.

sentences.zh: 貞元十一年七月，生於大明宮之別殿。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of Zhenyuan 11 he was born in a side hall of Daming Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He was born at Daming Palace in Zhenyuan 11's seventh month.

sentences.zh: 初名宥，元和元年八月，進封遂王。

translations.literal: His first name was You; in the eighth month of Yuanhe 1 he was advanced to Prince of Suí.
translations.idiomatic: First named You, he became Prince of Suí in Yuanhe 1.

sentences.zh: 五年三月，領彰義軍節度大使。

translations.literal: In the third month of year 5 he served as Zhangyi army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanhe 5's third month he took the Zhangyi command.

sentences.zh: 七年十月，冊為皇太了，改今諱。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of year 7 he was installed as crown prince and received his present taboo name.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanhe 7's tenth month he was made heir and renamed Heng.

sentences.zh: 元和十五年十五年正月庚子，憲宗崩。

translations.literal: In the first month of Yuanhe 15, on gengzi, Xianzong died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in Yuanhe 15's first month Xianzong died.

sentences.zh: 丙午，即皇帝位於太極殿東序。

translations.literal: On bingwu he took the throne in the eastern wing of Taiji Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he ascended at Taiji Hall's east wing.

sentences.zh: 是日，召翰林學士段文昌杜元穎沈傳師李肇、侍讀薛放丁公著對於思政殿，並賜金紫。

translations.literal: That day he summoned Hanlin academicians Duan Wenchang, Du Yuanying, Shen Chuanshi, and Li Zhao, and readers Xue Fang and Ding Gongzhu, to audience at Sizheng Hall, all granted gold-purple.
translations.idiomatic: That day he called six scholars to Sizheng Hall and gave them gold-purple.

sentences.zh: 丁未，集群臣班於月華門外。

translations.literal: On dingwei he assembled the ministers in ranks outside Yuehua Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the court lined up outside Yuehua Gate.

sentences.zh: 貶門下侍郎、平章事皇甫鎛為崖州司戶。

translations.literal: Vice premier Huangfu Bo was demoted to clerk of Yazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Bo was banished to Yazhou as a clerk.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上見宰臣於紫宸門外。

translations.literal: On wushen the Emperor received the chief ministers outside Zichen Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Muzong met his premiers at Zichen Gate.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以朝議郎、守御史中丞、飛騎尉、襲徐國公、賜緋魚袋蕭俛為朝散大夫、守中書；

translations.literal: On xinhai Xiao Mian, Court Gentleman for Discussion, acting Vice Censor-in-Chief, Flying Cavalry Captain, heir to Duke of Xu, granted scarlet fish bag, was made Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, acting Secretariat Director;
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Xiao Mian was made acting Secretariat director;

sentences.zh: 舍人、翰林學士、武騎尉、賜紫金魚段文昌為中書侍郎：同平章事。

translations.literal: Duan Wenchang, Secretariat drafter, Hanlin academician, Martial Cavalry Captain, granted purple-gold fish, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: and Duan Wenchang became vice premier.

sentences.zh: 上始御延英對宰臣。

translations.literal: The Emperor first held court at Yanying to face the chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Muzong began regular audiences at Yanying.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「山人柳泌輕懷左道。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The mountain man Liu Bi lightly harbored heterodox ways.
translations.idiomatic: An edict condemned Liu Bi:

sentences.zh: 上惑先朝。

translations.literal: He deluded the late emperor.
translations.idiomatic: "He had deluded Xianzong.

sentences.zh: 固求牧人，貴欲疑眾，自知虛誕，仍更遁逃。

translations.literal: He stubbornly sought to shepherd the people, prized casting doubt on the multitude, knew himself false, yet fled again.
translations.idiomatic: He posed as a people's savior while knowing his fraud, then fled again.

sentences.zh: 僧大通醫方不精，藥術皆妄。

translations.literal: The monk Da Tong's medical formulas were unskilled; all his drug arts were false.
translations.idiomatic: The monk Da Tong's medicine was worthless.

sentences.zh: 既延禍釁，俱是奸邪。

translations.literal: Having drawn calamity, both were wicked.
translations.idiomatic: Both had brought disaster and were traitors.

sentences.zh: 邦國固有常刑，人神所宜共棄，付京兆府決杖處死。

translations.literal: The state has fixed punishments; gods and men alike should cast them out — deliver them to Jingzhao prefecture for beating to death."
translations.idiomatic: Let Jingzhao beat them to death." Thus ended the edict.

sentences.zh: 」金吾將軍李道古貶循州司馬。

translations.literal: Gold Crow guard general Li Daogu was demoted to Sima of Xunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Daogu was demoted to Xunzhou.

sentences.zh: 憲宗未年，銳於服餌，皇甫鎛與李道古薦術人柳泌、僧大通待詔翰林。

translations.literal: In Xianzong's last years he was keen on elixirs; Huangfu Bo and Li Daogu recommended the adept Liu Bi and monk Da Tong as Hanlin awaiting edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Late in his reign Xianzong took elixirs pushed by Huangfu Bo, Li Daogu, Liu Bi, and Da Tong.

sentences.zh: 泌於台州為上鍊神丹，上服之，日加躁渴，遽棄萬國。

translations.literal: Liu Bi refined an immortal pill for the Emperor at Taizhou; after the Emperor took it daily thirst and frenzy grew, and he suddenly abandoned the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Bi's Taizhou elixir drove Xianzong to fevered thirst and sudden death.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，二王後介國公宇文仲達卒，有司與舊典葬祭之。

translations.literal: On jiayin the second-rank heir to the state of Ji, Duke of Jie, Yuwen Zhongda, died; the offices buried and sacrificed by old precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Yuwen Zhongda died and received state rites.

sentences.zh: 以監察御史李德裕、右拾遺李紳、禮部員外郎庾敬休並守本官，充翰林學士。

translations.literal: Supervising censor Li Deyu, Right Reminder Li Shen, and Rituals Bureau vice director Yu Jingxiu were all ordered to keep their posts and serve as Hanlin academicians.
translations.idiomatic: Li Deyu, Li Shen, and Yu Jingxiu joined the Hanlin.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以劍南東川節度使李逢吉為襄州刺史，充山南東道節度使；

translations.literal: On dingsi Li Fengji, military commissioner of eastern Sichuan, was made Yan prefect and Shannan East military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Li Fengji took Shannan East;

sentences.zh: 以吏部侍郎王涯檢校禮部尚書、梓州刺史，充劍南東川節度使。

translations.literal: Wang Ya, Vice Minister of Personnel, was made acting Minister of Rites and Zi prefect, eastern Sichuan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: and Wang Ya took eastern Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 己未，改恆岳為鎮岳，恆州來鎮州，定州恆陽縣為曲陽縣。

translations.literal: On jiwei Heng Mountain was renamed Zhen Mountain, Heng prefecture came under Zhen prefecture, and Hengyang county of Ding prefecture became Quyang county.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei taboo names and toponyms around Heng were revised.

sentences.zh: 恆王房子孫改為泜王房。

translations.literal: The house of Prince Heng was renamed the house of Prince Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Heng's lineage was renamed for Zhi.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以右神策大將軍張維清為單于大都護，充振武麟勝節度使。

translations.literal: On bingyin Right Divine Strategy Grand General Zhang Weiqing was made Protector-General of the Xiongnu and Zhensheng military commissioner of Zhenwu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Zhang Weiqing took Zhenwu.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上及群臣皆釋服從吉。

translations.literal: On dingmao the Emperor and all ministers put off mourning and followed auspicious rites.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao court mourning ended.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，群臣始朝於宣政衙。

translations.literal: On wuchen the ministers first attended court at Xuanzheng yamen.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen regular audiences resumed.

sentences.zh: 是夜地震。

translations.literal: That night there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That night the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 庚午，冊大行皇帝貴妃郭氏為皇太后。

translations.literal: On gengwu the late emperor's honored consort Guo was installed as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Guo became empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 貶諫議大夫李景儉為建州刺史。

translations.literal: Remonstrance official Li Jingjian was demoted to prefect of Jianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jingjian was sent to Jianzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉朔。

translations.literal: Second month, guiyou new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The second month opened on guiyou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，御丹鳳樓，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On dingchou he ascended Danfeng Tower and proclaimed a great amnesty for the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Muzong proclaimed universal amnesty from Danfeng Tower.

sentences.zh: 宣制畢，陳俳優百戲於丹鳳門內，上縱觀之。

translations.literal: When the proclamation ended, jesters and a hundred entertainments were arrayed inside Danfeng Gate; the Emperor watched freely.
translations.idiomatic: After the amnesty he watched jesters inside Danfeng Gate.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，幸左神策軍觀角抵及雜戲，日昃而罷。

translations.literal: On dinghai he visited the Left Divine Strategy Army to watch wrestling and miscellaneous plays, stopping at sunset.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he spent the day at the Left Divine Strategy Army watching games.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，罷邕管經略使，所管州縣隸邕府。

translations.literal: On guisi the Yong circuit military commissioner was abolished; its prefectures and counties were placed under Yong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the Yong commissioner post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以桂管觀察使裴行立為安南都護，充本管經略使。

translations.literal: On jiawu Gui observation commissioner Pei Xingli was made Protector of Annan and military commissioner of that circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Pei Xingli took Annan.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以太僕卿杜式方為桂州刺史，充桂管觀察使。

translations.literal: On yiwei Grand Master of the Stud Du Shifang was made Gui prefect and Gui observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Du Shifang took Gui circuit.

sentences.zh: 丙申，丹王逾薨。

translations.literal: On bingshen Prince Dan died.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Dan died on bingshen.

sentences.zh: 丁酉。

translations.literal: On dingyou.
translations.idiomatic: The annal records dingyou without further entry.

sentences.zh: 敕入回紇使宜與私覿正員官十三員，入吐蕃使與八員。

translations.literal: An order: Uighur envoys were to receive private audiences with thirteen regular officials; Tibet envoys with eight.
translations.idiomatic: Uighur and Tibet envoys were allotted fixed numbers of private audience partners.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太子賓客呂元膺卒。

translations.literal: On gengzi Crown Prince Mentor Lü Yuanying died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Lü Yuanying died.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以戶部侍郎楊於陵為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On xinchou Vice Minister of Revenue Yang Yuling was made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Yang Yuling became revenue minister.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，敕舉賢良方正、直言極諫等科目人，宜令中書門下尚書省四品已上於尚書省同試。

translations.literal: On renyin an edict: candidates for Worthy and Upright, Direct Remonstrance, and similar degrees were to be examined jointly at the Ministry of Personnel by Secretariat and Department chiefs of fourth rank and above.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin an edict required high ministers to co-examine special-degree candidates at Personnel.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯朔，贈皇太后父郭曖太傅，母虢國大長公主贈齊國大長公主。

translations.literal: Third month, guimao new moon — the empress dowager's father Guo Ai was posthumously made Grand Tutor; her mother, Grand Princess of Guo, was posthumously made Grand Princess of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: The third month opened with posthumous honors for the Guo clan.

sentences.zh: 壬子，召侍講學士韋處厚、路隨於太液亭講《毛詩關雎》、《尚書洪範》等篇。

translations.literal: On renzi lecture masters Wei Chuhou and Lu Sui were summoned to Taiye Pavilion to lecture on "Guanju" from the Book of Odes and the "Hongfan" chapter of the Documents.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Wei Chuhou and Lu Sui lectured the heir on Odes and Documents.

sentences.zh: 既罷，並賜緋魚袋。

translations.literal: When finished, both were granted scarlet fish bags.
translations.idiomatic: Both received scarlet fish bags.

sentences.zh: 左右軍中尉馬進潭、梁守謙、魏弘簡等請立門戟，從之。

translations.literal: Left and Right Army commissioners Ma Jintan, Liang Shouqian, Wei Hongjian, and others requested gate halberds — approved.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch army commissioners received gate halberds.

sentences.zh: 以太子詹事分司東都韋貫之為河南尹。

translations.literal: Wei Guanzhi, crown prince mentor at eastern Luoyang, was made Henan intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Guanzhi became Henan intendant.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，御史中丞崔植奏：「元和十二年敕，御史臺三院御史據除拜上日為先後，未上日不得計月數。

translations.literal: On dingsi Vice Censor-in-Chief Cui Zhi memorialized: "The Yuanhe 12 edict set Censorate thirds by the day of appointment, not counting months before reporting;
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Cui Zhi asked to fix censor seniority by appointment date alone;

sentences.zh: 又準其年九月十七日敕，逾一個月不在此限，行立班次，即宜以敕內先後為定。

translations.literal: also per the ninth-month seventeenth-day edict of that year, beyond one month was not within the limit — standing order should follow the edict's sequence.
translations.idiomatic: arguing later rules conflicted with the Yuanhe 12 rule.

sentences.zh: 臣觀此後敕未便事宜，請自今後三院御史職事行立，一切依敕文先後為定，除拜上日便為月數。

translations.literal: I see the later edict is inconvenient; from now on all censorial standing and duty shall follow the edict sequence, and the appointment day counts as the month."
translations.idiomatic: He asked that standing order follow original appointment order."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The throne agreed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，吏部尚書趙宗儒奏：「先奉敕，先朝所放制科舉人，令與中書門下四品已上官同於尚書省就試者。

translations.literal: On wuwu Personnel Minister Zhao Zongru memorialized: "We earlier received an edict that special-degree candidates released by the late reign should test with Secretariat and Department chiefs of fourth rank and above at the Ministry.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Zhao Zongru asked to cancel the joint special-degree examination;

sentences.zh: 臣伏以制科所設，本在親臨，南省策試，亦非舊典。

translations.literal: I submit that special degrees were instituted for the ruler's personal presence; southern-examination testing is not old precedent.
translations.idiomatic: saying the emperor should examine them in person, not at Personnel.

sentences.zh: 今覃恩既畢，庶政惟新，況山陵日近，公務繁迫，待問之士，就試非多。

translations.literal: Now grace is complete and government renewed; moreover the imperial tomb nears and public business presses — candidates to be questioned are not many.
translations.idiomatic: With the tomb approaching and few candidates ready,

sentences.zh: 臣等商量，恐須停罷。

translations.literal: We have discussed and fear it should be suspended."
translations.idiomatic: the joint exam should be halted."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The throne agreed.

sentences.zh: 罷申州歲貢茶。

translations.literal: Shen prefecture's annual tea tribute was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Shenzhou's tea tribute ended.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以皇太后兄司農卿郭釗為刑部尚書兼司農卿，右金吾衛大將軍郭鏦檢校工部尚書。

translations.literal: On yichou the empress dowager's brother Guo Zhao, Minister of Agriculture, was made Minister of Justice while retaining Agriculture; Guo Cong, grand general of the Right Gold Crow Guard, was made acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Guo Zhao and Guo Cong were promoted.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，貶太子賓客留司東都孟簡為吉州員外司馬。

translations.literal: On dingmao crown prince mentor Meng Jian, retained at eastern Luoyang, was demoted to external Sima of Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Meng Jian was banished to Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰夜，大風雹。

translations.literal: On wuchen night a great wind and hail.
translations.idiomatic: That night wind and hail struck.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申朔。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, renshen new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth month opened on renshen.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，澧王薨。

translations.literal: On dingchou Prince Li died.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Li died on dingchou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，三恪酅國公楊造卒。

translations.literal: On yiyou the third-rank heir of the House of Zhou, Duke of Ye, Yang Zao, died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Yang Zao died.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，敕：「內侍省見管高品官白身，都四千六百一十八人，除官員一千六百九十六人外，其餘單貧，無屋室居止，宜每人加衣糧半分。

translations.literal: On dinghai an edict: "The Palace Domestic Service now supervises 4,618 high-rank white-body eunuchs; apart from 1,696 with offices, the rest are destitute without dwellings — each should receive an extra half-share of clothing grain."
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai an edict increased grain for destitute palace eunuchs.

translations.literal: The edict closed with the closing bracket.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended the edict.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅朔。

translations.literal: Fifth month, renyin new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth month opened on renyin.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔：「以國用不足，應天下兩稅、鹽利、榷酒、稅茶及戶部闕官、除陌等錢，兼諸道雜榷稅等，應合送上都及留州、留使、諸道支用、諸司使職掌人課料等錢，並每貫除舊墊陌外，量抽五十文。

translations.literal: On guimao an edict: "Because state revenue is insufficient, on all two-tax, salt-profit, wine monopoly, tea tax, Ministry vacancies, removal-fee, and miscellaneous circuit levies due to the capital or retained in prefectures, commissioners' salaries, and the like — beyond the old cushion fee per string, fifty cash are to be drawn;
translations.idiomatic: On guimao an edict levied fifty cash per string on major taxes and levies;

sentences.zh: 仍委本道、本司、本使據數逐季收計。

translations.literal: each circuit, office, and commissioner is to collect and account quarterly.
translations.idiomatic: with quarterly collection and accounting.

sentences.zh: 其諸道錢便差綱部送付度支收管，待國用稍充，即依舊制。

translations.literal: Circuit funds are to be sent by transport to Revenue for custody; when state use is somewhat ample, the old system returns.
translations.idiomatic: Funds went to Revenue until finances recovered.

sentences.zh: 其京百司俸料，文官已抽修國學，不可重有抽取；

translations.literal: Capital offices' salaries — civil officials already taxed for the National University cannot be taxed again;
translations.idiomatic: Civil salaries already tapped for the university were exempt;

sentences.zh: 武官所給校薄，亦不在抽取之限。

translations.literal: military pay, being thin, is also outside the levy."
translations.idiomatic: military pay was exempt as well." Thus ended the edict.

sentences.zh: 」壬子，詔：「入景陵玄宮合供千味食，魚肉肥鮮，恐致薰穢，宜令尚藥局以香藥代食。

translations.literal: On renzi an edict: "For the thousand flavors offered in Jingling's spirit vault, fish and rich meat may cause foul vapors — the Imperial Pharmacy should substitute fragrant drugs for food."
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the court ordered fragrant substitutes for meat at Jingling.

sentences.zh: 」庚申，葬憲宗於景陵。

translations.literal: On gengshen Xianzong was buried at Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzong entered Jingling tomb on gengshen.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未朔。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinwei new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth month opened on xinwei.

sentences.zh: ，丁丑，以司徒、兼中書令韓弘為河中尹，充河中晉絳慈隰等州節度使。

translations.literal: On dingchou Han Hong, Grand Mentor and concurrent Grand Councillor, was made Hezhong intendant and He-Jin-Min-Ci military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Han Hong took the Hezhong command.

sentences.zh: 安南都護桂仲武奏誅賊首楊清，收復安南府戊寅，以金吾將軍李祐檢校左散騎常侍，兼夏州刺史，充夏綏銀宥節度使，代李聽。

translations.literal: Annan Protector Gui Zhongwu memorialized that rebel chief Yang Qing was executed and Annan prefecture recovered; on wuyin Li You, Gold Crow guard general, was made acting Left Regular Cavalry Attendant, concurrent Xia prefect, and Xia-Sui-Yin-You military commissioner, replacing Li Ting.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Zhongwu recovered Annan; on wuyin Li You replaced Li Ting on the northwest frontier.

sentences.zh: 以聽為靈州大都督府長史，充朔方靈鹽節度使。

translations.literal: Li Ting was made chief of Ling prefecture and Shuofang-Ling-Salt military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ting took Shuofang.

sentences.zh: 以中書舍人王仲舒為洪州刺史、御史中丞，充江西觀察使。

translations.literal: Wang Zhongshu, Secretariat drafter, was made Hong prefect, Vice Censor-in-Chief, and Jiangxi observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhongshu took Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 己卯，放京兆府今年夏青苗錢八萬三千五百六十貫，宜委令狐楚，以楚山陵用不盡綾絹，準實估付京兆府，代所放青苗錢。

translations.literal: On jimao 83,560 strings of capital summer green-seed tax were remitted; Linghu Chu was ordered to pay the capital with surplus tomb silks at fair value in place of the remitted tax.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the capital's summer seed tax was remitted via Linghu Chu's tomb surplus.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，加邠、寧、慶節度使李光顏特進，以城鹽州之功也。

translations.literal: On gengchen Bin-Ning-Qing military commissioner Li Guangyan was given special advancement for building Salt prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Li Guangyan was promoted for fortifying Saltzhou.

sentences.zh: 以考功員外郎、史館修撰李翱為朗州刺史，坐與李景儉相善故也。

translations.literal: Li Ao, Director of Merit in the Bureau of Personnel and History Office compiler, was made Lang prefect for friendship with Li Jingjian.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ao was exiled to Langzhou for siding with Li Jingjian.

sentences.zh: 癸未，並兗州萊蕪縣入乾封縣。

translations.literal: On guiwei Laiwu county of Yan prefecture was merged into Qianfeng county.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Laiwu was abolished into Qianfeng.

sentences.zh: 己丑，工部尚書歸登卒。

translations.literal: On jichou Minister of Works Gui Deng died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Gui Deng died.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔：「帝王所重者國體，所切者人情。

translations.literal: On renchen an edict: "What emperors weight is the state's body; what they cut to is human feeling.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Muzong revoked the fifty-cash levy:

sentences.zh: 茍得其體，必臻於大和；

translations.literal: If the body is secured, great harmony is reached;
translations.idiomatic: "A ruler who keeps the state's body attains great harmony;

sentences.zh: 如失其情，是由於小利。

translations.literal: if feeling is lost, it is from small profit.
translations.idiomatic: but small profit betrays the people's feeling.

sentences.zh: 況設官求理，頒祿責功，教既有常，寧宜就減。

translations.literal: Moreover offices are set to seek order and salaries issued to demand achievement — instruction has its constants; how should it be reduced?
translations.idiomatic: Salaries reward service and must not be casually stripped.

sentences.zh: 近以每歲經費，量入數少，外官俸料，據數收貫。

translations.literal: Recently yearly outlays were measured and receipts few; outer officials' salaries were taxed per string.
translations.idiomatic: The new per-string tax on outer salaries troubled me.

sentences.zh: 朕再三思度，終所未安。

translations.literal: I thought again and again and was never at ease.
translations.idiomatic: I could not accept it.

sentences.zh: 今則歲屬豐登，兵方偃息，自宜克己以足用，何得剝下以為謀。

translations.literal: Now the year is abundant and arms rest — one should restrain oneself to suffice; how take from below for schemes?
translations.idiomatic: In a year of peace the throne should tighten its belt, not peel the provinces.

sentences.zh: 臨軒載懷，實所增愧。

translations.literal: Facing the hall I carry shame.
translations.idiomatic: I am ashamed before the court.

sentences.zh: 其今年五月敕應給用錢每貫抽五十文，都計一百五十萬貫，宜並停抽。

translations.literal: This year's fifth-month edict drawing fifty cash per string, totaling 1,500,000 strings, is entirely to cease."
translations.idiomatic: Cancel the 1,500,000-string levy entirely." Thus ended the edict.

sentences.zh: 」仍出內庫錢三十七萬五千貫，付度支給用。

translations.literal: Still 375,000 strings from the inner treasury were issued to Revenue for use.
translations.idiomatic: Revenue also received 375,000 strings from the inner treasury.

sentences.zh: 初，憲宗用兵，擢皇甫鎛為相，苛斂剝下，人皆咎之，以至譴逐。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Xianzong used troops, Huangfu Bo was raised to premier and harshly taxed the people — all blamed him, hence his banishment.
translations.idiomatic: The levy had echoed Huangfu Bo's hated exactions; popular anger forced its repeal.

sentences.zh: 至是宰臣創抽貫之利，制下，人情不悅，故罷之。

translations.literal: At this time the chief ministers had devised the per-string levy; when the order went down popular feeling was displeased, hence it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers' levy proved so unpopular that Muzong repealed it.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，皇太后移居興慶宮，皇帝與六宮侍從大合宴於南內，回幸右軍，頒賜中尉等有差。

translations.literal: On guisi the empress dowager moved to Xingqing Palace; the Emperor and the six palaces held a great feast in the southern inner palace, then returned to the Right Army and bestowed graded rewards on the commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the court feasted the empress dowager at Xingqing and rewarded the eunuch commissioners.

sentences.zh: 自是凡三日一幸左右軍及御宸暉、九仙等門，觀角抵、雜戲。

translations.literal: From then he visited the Left and Right Armies and Yuchenhui, Jiuxian, and other gates every three days to watch wrestling and miscellaneous plays.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter he toured the armies and palace gates every three days for games.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛朔。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, xin day new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh month opened on a xin day.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以河中、晉、絳觀察使李絳為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On renyin Li Jiang, observer of He-Jin-Min, was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Li Jiang became war minister.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以大理卿孔戢為潭州刺史、湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: On jiachen Grand Judge of Dali Kong Zhi was made Tan prefect and Hunan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Kong Zhi took Hunan.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔：「皇太后就安長樂，朝夕承顏，慈訓所加，慶感兼極。

translations.literal: On yisi an edict: "The empress dowager dwells at peace in Chang-le; morning and evening she receives my face — her kindly instruction adds, and gratitude is utmost.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi an edict ordered birthday homage to the empress dowager:

sentences.zh: 今月六日是朕載誕之辰，奉迎皇太后於宮中上壽。

translations.literal: The sixth of this month is the day of my birth; I shall welcome the empress dowager into the palace to receive longevity wishes.
translations.idiomatic: "On my birthday I will bring her into the palace for congratulations.

sentences.zh: 朕既深歡慰，欲與臣下同之。

translations.literal: I am deeply pleased and wish to share with the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: I wish the whole court to share the joy.

sentences.zh: 其日，百僚、命婦宜於光順門進名參賀，朕於光順門內殿與百僚相見，永為常式。

translations.literal: That day, the hundred officials and titled wives should advance names in congratulation at Guangshun Gate; I shall meet the hundred officials in the inner hall at Guangshun Gate — forever the regular form."
translations.idiomatic: Let officials and consorts salute at Guangshun Gate; I will receive them within — as permanent custom." Thus ended the edict.

sentences.zh: 」非典也。

translations.literal: This was irregular precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Historians noted this birthday ceremony was unprecedented.

sentences.zh: 鄆曹濮等州節度賜號天平軍，從馬總奏也。

translations.literal: The Yan-Cao-Pu circuit military commissioner was given the title Ping'an Army, following Ma Zong's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Yan-Cao-Pu was renamed the Ping'an Army at Ma Zong's request.

sentences.zh: 丙午，敕：乙巳詔書載誕受賀儀宜停。

translations.literal: On bingwu an order: the yisi edict's birthday congratulations were to stop.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the birthday homage edict was rescinded.

sentences.zh: 先是，左丞韋綬奏行之，宰臣以古無降誕受賀之禮，奏罷之。

translations.literal: Earlier Left Vice Director Wei Shou had memorialized to carry it out; the chief ministers said antiquity had no birthday congratulations, and memorialized to abolish it.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Shou had proposed it; the premiers cited antiquity and had it canceled.

sentences.zh: 丁未，苑內假山毀。

translations.literal: On dingwei artificial hills in the park were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei park artificial hills collapsed.

sentences.zh: 壓死役者七人。

translations.literal: Seven laborers were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: Seven workers died in the collapse.

sentences.zh: 自五月五雨，至此月壬子始雨。

translations.literal: From the fifth month's fifth day it rained; only on this month's renzi did rain begin.
translations.idiomatic: Rain that had held since early summer finally came on renzi.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，御新成永安殿觀百戲，極歡而罷。

translations.literal: On jiayin he ascended the newly completed Yong'an Hall to watch a hundred plays, ending in utmost joy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Muzong opened Yong'an Hall with a day of revelry.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，敕自今後新除節度、觀察使到任日，具見在錢帛、斛斗、器械數目分析以聞。

translations.literal: On yimao an order: from now on newly appointed military and observation commissioners, on the day of assuming office, shall itemize present cash, silk, grain, and weapons and report.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao new commissioners had to inventory circuit assets on arrival.

sentences.zh: 安南都護行立卒。

translations.literal: Annan Protector Xingli died.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Xingli died in Annan.

sentences.zh: 是日，上幸安國寺觀盂蘭盆。

translations.literal: That day the Emperor visited Anguo Temple to watch the Ghost Festival rites.
translations.idiomatic: That day he watched Ullambana at Anguo Temple.

sentences.zh: 邕管經略使楊旻卒。

translations.literal: Yong circuit military commissioner Yang Min died.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Min died on the Yong frontier.

sentences.zh: 平盧軍新加押新羅、渤海兩蕃使，賜印一面，許置巡官一人。

translations.literal: Pinglu Army newly added envoys to Silla and Bohai, granted one seal, and was permitted one touring official.
translations.idiomatic: Pinglu gained Silla and Bohai envoy posts with a seal and touring officer.

sentences.zh: 新作寶慶殿。

translations.literal: The new Baoxing Hall was built.
translations.idiomatic: Baoxing Hall was completed.

sentences.zh: 庚申夜，熒惑入羽林。

translations.literal: On gengshen night Mars entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen night Mars entered the Feathered Forest guard.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，盛飾安國、慈恩、千福、開業、章敬等寺，縱吐蕃使者觀之。

translations.literal: On renxu Anguo, Cien, Qianfu, Kaiye, Zhangjing, and other temples were lavishly decorated, and Tibet envoys were allowed to watch.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu temples were gilded for Tibet envoys to tour.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以新成永安殿，與中宮貴主密宴以樂之，嬪妃皆預。

translations.literal: On bingyin, because the new Yong'an Hall was finished, he held a secret feast with the inner palace's noble ladies to celebrate with music; concubines all attended.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he feasted consorts privately in the new Yong'an Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以門下待郎、平章事令狐楚為宣州刺史、兼御史大夫，充宣、歙、池觀察使。

translations.literal: On dingmao Vice Premier Linghu Chu was made Xuan prefect, concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief, and Xuan-She-Chi observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Linghu Chu was demoted to Xuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 楚為山陵使，縱吏於翬刻下，不給工徒價錢，積留錢十五萬貫，為羨餘以獻，故及於貶。

translations.literal: Chu had been tomb commissioner and let clerks under carving contractors go unpaid, hoarding 150,000 strings as surplus to present — hence the demotion.
translations.idiomatic: He had skimmed 150,000 strings from tomb labor, prompting exile.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午朔。

translations.literal: Eighth month, gengwu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth month opened on gengwu.

sentences.zh: 辛未，兵部尚書楊於陵總百僚錢貨輕重之議，取天下兩稅、榷酒、鹽利等，悉以布帛任土所產物充稅，並不徵見錢，則物漸重，錢漸輕，農人見免賤賣匹段。

translations.literal: On xinwei War Minister Yang Yuling summarized debate on light and heavy money, taking all two-tax, wine monopoly, and salt profits nationwide and ordering taxes paid in local cloth and goods, not collecting cash, so goods would gradually weigh heavy and cash light, and farmers would be spared selling cheap cloth.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Yang Yuling urged tax payment in kind rather than cash.

sentences.zh: 請中書門下、御史臺諸官長重議施行。

translations.literal: He asked Secretariat, Department, and Censorate chiefs to reconsider and implement.
translations.idiomatic: High ministers were told to review the plan.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The throne agreed.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，太子少傅致仕李鄘卒。

translations.literal: On guiyou retired Crown Prince Junior Tutor Li Yong died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Li Yong died in retirement.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，安南都護桂仲武斬叛將楊清首以獻，收復安南府。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Annan Protector Gui Zhongwu beheaded rebel general Yang Qing and presented the head, recovering Annan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Gui Zhongwu beheaded Yang Qing and recovered Annan.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，賜教坊錢五千貫，充息利本錢。

translations.literal: On yihai 5,000 strings were granted to the Music Office as capital for interest.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the Music Office received 5,000 strings capital.

sentences.zh: 御勤政樓，問人疾苦。

translations.literal: He ascended Diligence-in-Government Tower and inquired into people's hardships.
translations.idiomatic: He held a public audience on popular hardship.

sentences.zh: 前江西觀察使裴次元卒。

translations.literal: Former Jiangxi observation commissioner Pei Ciyuan died.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Ciyuan died.

sentences.zh: 己卯，月掩牽牛。

translations.literal: On jimao the moon occulted the Ox.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the moon eclipsed the Ox constellation.

sentences.zh: 同州雨雪，害秋稼。

translations.literal: Tong prefecture had rain and snow, harming autumn crops.
translations.idiomatic: Early snow in Tongzhou damaged the harvest.

sentences.zh: 京兆府戶曹參軍韋正牧專知景陵工作，刻削廚料充私用，計贓八千七百貫文；

translations.literal: Wei Zhengmu, household section aide of Jingzhao prefecture, solely managed Jingling construction, shaved kitchen provisions for private use, embezzling 8,700 strings;
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhengmu embezzled 8,700 strings from Jingling works;

sentences.zh: 石作專知官奉仙縣令於翬刻削，計贓一萬三千貫，並宜決重杖處死。

translations.literal: Yu's carving contractor Fengxian magistrate Yu Hui also shaved funds, embezzling 13,000 strings — both were to be beaten to death with heavy rods.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Hui embezzled 13,000 more; both were sentenced to beating death.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，幸魚藻池，發神策軍二千人浚魚藻池。

translations.literal: On renchen he visited Fish-Algae Pool; 2,000 Divine Strategy troops were sent to dredge it.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he toured Fish-Algae Pool and ordered it dredged.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以朝議郎、守御史中丞、武騎尉、賜紫金魚袋崔植為朝散大夫、守中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On wuxu Cui Zhi, Court Gentleman for Discussion, acting Vice Censor-in-Chief, Martial Cavalry Captain, granted purple-gold fish, was made Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, acting Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Cui Zhi entered the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 己亥，宣歙觀察使令狐楚再貶衡州刺史。

translations.literal: On jihai Xuan-She observer Linghu Chu was demoted again to Heng prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Linghu Chu was demoted again to Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子朔，改河北稅鹽使為榷鹽使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, gengzi new moon — the Hebei salt-tax commissioner was renamed salt monopoly commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The ninth month opened with renaming the Hebei salt office.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，大合樂於魚藻宮，觀競渡。

translations.literal: On xinchou great music was assembled at Fish-Algae Palace to watch boat racing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the court watched regatta races at Fish-Algae Palace.

sentences.zh: 又召李愬、李光顏入朝，欲於重陽日宴群臣。

translations.literal: Li Su and Li Guangyan were again summoned to court; the Emperor wished to feast the ministers on Double Yang day.
translations.idiomatic: Li Su and Li Guangyan were recalled for a planned Double Yang feast.

sentences.zh: 拾遺李玨等上疏諫云：「元朔未改，園陵尚新。

translations.literal: Remonstrator Li Jue and others memorialized: "The new reign's calendar is not yet changed; the imperial tomb is still fresh.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jue protested that mourning for Xianzong was not finished:

sentences.zh: 雖易月之期，俯從人欲；

translations.literal: Though bending the month's term follows human desire,
translations.idiomatic: "Though the court might bend ritual deadlines,

sentences.zh: 而三年之制，猶服心喪。

translations.literal: the three-year rule still binds the heart in mourning.
translations.idiomatic: the three-year mourning still binds the heart.

sentences.zh: 夫遏密弛禁，蓋為齊人；

translations.literal: Stopping music and loosening prohibitions is for comforting the people;
translations.idiomatic: Music in the inner palace before the tomb is closed

sentences.zh: 合樂內庭，事將未可。

translations.literal: assembling music within the palace is not yet permissible."
translations.idiomatic: should not yet be allowed."

sentences.zh: 」不聽。

translations.literal: He did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Muzong ignored them.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以駕部郎中、知制誥李宗閔為中書舍人。

translations.literal: On yisi Drafting Bureau director Li Zongmin was made Secretariat drafter.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Li Zongmin joined the drafting office.

sentences.zh: 宋州大水，損田六千頃。

translations.literal: Song prefecture flooded, damaging 6,000 qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: Songzhou flood ruined six thousand qing.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以重陽節曲宴郭釗兄弟、貴戚、主婿等於宣和殿。

translations.literal: On wushen on Double Yang he held a private feast for Guo Zhao's brothers, noble kin, and imperial sons-in-law at Xuanhe Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Muzong feasted the Guo clan on Double Yang.

sentences.zh: 己酉，大酺三日，至是雨雪，樹木無風而摧僕者十五六。

translations.literal: On jiyou a great carousal lasted three days; by then rain and snow came, and trees without wind collapsed fifteen or sixteen.
translations.idiomatic: A three-day revel ended in snow that felled trees without wind.

sentences.zh: 以吏部侍郎崔群為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Personnel Cui Qun was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Qun became censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 滄、景水，損田。

translations.literal: Cang and Jing flooded, damaging fields.
translations.idiomatic: Cangzhou and Jingzhou floods damaged crops.

sentences.zh: 戊午，加河東節度使、金紫光錄大夫、檢校尚書右僕射、兼門下侍郎、同平章事、太原尹、北都留守、上柱國、晉國公、食邑三千戶裴度守司空、門下侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: On wuwu Hedong military commissioner Pei Du, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, acting Minister of Personnel, concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councillor, Pillar of State, Duke of Jin with 3,000 households, was made acting Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Pei Du was promoted within the council.

sentences.zh: 以邠寧節度使、檢校司空、邠州刺史、上柱國、武威郡開國公、食邑二千戶李光顏並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Bin-Ning military commissioner Li Guangyan was also made Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangyan joined the council as well.

sentences.zh: 又武寧軍節度使、徐泗濠等州觀察等使、檢校尚書左僕射、徐州刺史、上柱國、涼國公、食邑三千戶李愬為同中書門下平章事、潞州大都督府長史，充昭義軍節度、澤潞磁邢洺觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: Wuning military commissioner Li Su was made Grand Councillor, chief of Luoyang in Zhaoyi, and Zhaoyi military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Su was made councilor and sent to Zhaoyi.

sentences.zh: 夏州奏移宥州於長澤縣置。

translations.literal: Xia circuit memorialized moving You prefecture to Changze county.
translations.idiomatic: Xiazhou reported relocating You prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，宴李光顏、李愬於麟德殿，頒賜優厚。

translations.literal: On xinyou Li Guangyan and Li Su were feasted at Linde Hall with generous gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the court feasted Li Guangyan and Li Su at Linde.

sentences.zh: 以袁州刺史韓愈為朝散大夫、守國子祭酒，復賜金紫。

translations.literal: Han Yu, Yuan prefect, was made Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, acting National University Chancellor, and again granted gold-purple.
translations.idiomatic: Han Yu was restored as National University chancellor with gold-purple.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以御史大夫崔群檢校兵部尚書、徐州刺史，充武寧軍節度、徐泗宿濠觀察等使；

translations.literal: On bingyin Censor-in-Chief Cui Qun was made acting War Minister and Xu prefect, Wuning military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Cui Qun took Wuning;

sentences.zh: 以將作監崔能為廣州刺史，充嶺南節度使。

translations.literal: Director of Palace Construction Cui Neng was made Guang prefect and Lingnan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Neng took Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 丁卯以兵部尚書李絳為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On dingmao War Minister Li Jiang was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Li Jiang became censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以前嶺南節度使孔戣為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: On wuchen former Lingnan military commissioner Kong Zhi was made Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Kong Zhi returned to Personnel.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午朔，闍婆國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, gengwu new moon — Kanchi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Kanchi presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，宰相與吐蕃使於中書議事。

translations.literal: On gengchen the chief ministers met Tibet envoys at the Secretariat to discuss affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen premiers met Tibet envoys.

sentences.zh: 京百司共賜錢一萬貫，仰御史臺據司額大小、公事閑劇均之。

translations.literal: Capital offices together were granted 10,000 strings; the Censorate was to divide them by office size and business urgency.
translations.idiomatic: Capital offices received 10,000 strings apportioned by the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 成德軍節度使王承宗卒，其弟承元上表請朝廷命帥，遣起居舍人柏耆宣慰之。

translations.literal: Chengde military commissioner Wang Chengzong died; his brother Chengyuan memorialized asking the court to appoint a commander, and Attendant Gentleman Bai Qi was sent to comfort.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chengzong died; Chengyuan asked for a court appointee and Bai Qi was sent.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，金公亮修成指南車、記里鼓車。

translations.literal: On xinsi Jin Gongliang completed the south-pointing carriage and mile-drum carriage.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Jin Gongliang presented astronomical carriages.

sentences.zh: 壬午，吐蕃寇涇州，命中尉梁守謙將神策軍四千人及八鎮兵赴援。

translations.literal: On renwu Tibet raided Jing prefecture; Commissioner Liang Shouqian led 4,000 Divine Strategy troops and eight frontier armies to rescue.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Tibet raided Jingzhou; Liang Shouqian marched to relieve.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以魏博等州節度觀察等使、光祿大夫、檢校司徒、兼侍中、魏博大都督府長史、上柱國、沂國公、食邑三千戶、實封三百戶田弘正可檢校司徒、兼中書令、鎮州大都督府長史、成德軍節度、鎮冀深趙等州觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: On yiyou Tian Hongzheng, Weibo military commissioner, was made acting Minister of Works, concurrent Secretariat Vice Director, and Chengde military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Tian Hongzheng took Chengde.

sentences.zh: 以鎮冀深趙等觀察度支使、朝議郎、試金吾左衛胄曹參軍兼監察御史王承元可銀青光祿大夫、檢校工部尚書、使持節滑州諸軍事、守滑州刺史、御史大夫，充義成軍節度、鄭滑等州觀察等使。

translations.literal: Wang Chengyuan was made acting Works Minister, Hua prefect, and Yicheng military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chengyuan went to Yicheng on the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 以昭義節度使、檢校尚書左僕射、同中書門下平章事李愬可本官，為魏州大都督府長史，充魏博等州節度、觀察等使。

translations.literal: Li Su remained in office as chief of Wei prefecture and Weibo military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Su was shifted to Weibo.

sentences.zh: 以義成軍節度使劉悟依前檢校右僕射、兼潞州大都督府長史，充昭義節度、澤潞邢洺磁等州觀察等使。

translations.literal: Liu Wu, Yicheng military commissioner, was made acting Right Vice Director and chief of Luoyang in Zhaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wu took Zhaoyi from Li Su.

sentences.zh: 以左金吾將軍田布為檢校左散騎常侍、兼懷州刺史、御史大夫，充河陽三城懷孟節度使。

translations.literal: Left Gold Crow general Tian Bu was made acting Left Regular Cavalry Attendant, concurrent Huai prefect, and Heyang-Sancheng-Huai-Meng military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Bu received Heyang.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，涇州奏吐蕃退去。

translations.literal: On yiyou Jing prefecture reported Tibet had withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhou reported the Tibetans had withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 時夏州節度使田縉貪猥，侵刻黨項羌，羌引西蕃入寇，賴郝玼、李光顏奮命拒之，方退。

translations.literal: At the time Xia military commissioner Tian Ji was greedy and cruel, oppressing Tangut clans; the Tangut brought Western Tibet to raid, but Hao Qi and Li Guangyan fought desperately and they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Ji's oppression of Tanguts provoked a raid repelled by Hao Qi and Li Guangyan.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，西川奏吐蕃侵雅州，令發兵鎮守。

translations.literal: On dinghai western Sichuan reported Tibet invaded Ya prefecture; troops were ordered to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Ya prefecture was attacked; troops were sent.

sentences.zh: 東川節度使王涯陳破吐蕃策，言以厚賂北蕃，俾入西蕃，據地得人多少賞之。

translations.literal: Eastern Sichuan military commissioner Wang Ya proposed a plan to break Tibet by bribing northern Tibet to enter western Tibet and reward land and men seized.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ya proposed bribing northern Tibet against western Tibet.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙亥朔。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, yihai new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh month opened on yihai.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，制：「朕聞帝王丕宅四海，子育群生，如天無不覆，如日無不燭。

translations.literal: On guimao a decree: "I hear that emperors grandly dwell over the four seas and nurture the multitude, like heaven covering all, like the sun illuminating all.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao a decree celebrated Chengde's submission:

sentences.zh: 乃睠冀方，初喪戎帥，念乎三軍之事，洎於四州之人。

translations.literal: Looking to Ji, we first lost the military commander; I think of the three armies' affairs and reach to the four prefectures' people.
translations.idiomatic: "I mourned the lost commander and the people of four prefectures.

sentences.zh: 或懷忠積誠，而思用莫展；

translations.literal: Some stored loyalty and long sincerity yet had no way to show service;
translations.idiomatic: Loyal men had lacked scope;

sentences.zh: 或災荒兵役，而望恤何階。

translations.literal: some suffered disaster, famine, and military labor yet had no step for hoped relief.
translations.idiomatic: soldiers and farmers had lacked relief.

sentences.zh: 今則昌運一開，誠節咸著。

translations.literal: Now fortune opens and sincerity everywhere appears.
translations.idiomatic: Now fortune turns and sincerity shines.

sentences.zh: 王承元首陳章疏，願赴闕庭。

translations.literal: Wang Chengyuan first submitted a memorial wishing to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chengyuan was first to submit and come to court.

sentences.zh: 永念父兄之忠，克固君臣之義，已加殊獎，別委重籓。

translations.literal: Ever mindful of father and brother's loyalty, he secured ruler-minister righteousness; extraordinary reward was added and a heavy commandery entrusted.
translations.idiomatic: Honoring his family's loyalty, he received a new command.

sentences.zh: 又念成德軍將士等，葉謀向義，丹款載申，咸欲效其器能，各宜列之爵秩。

translations.literal: Thinking also of Chengde's officers and soldiers, who turned from plots to righteousness and declared red sincerity, all wishing to show ability — each should receive rank.
translations.idiomatic: Chengde troops who turned righteous were to be ranked.

sentences.zh: 大將史重歸、牛元翼已超授寵榮，今更都加厚賜。

translations.literal: Great generals Shi Chonggui and Niu Yuanyi already received surpassing honors; now all the more thick gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Generals Shi Chonggui and Niu Yuanyi were doubly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 宜令諫議大夫鄭覃往鎮州宣慰，賜錢一百萬貫。

translations.literal: Remonstrance official Zheng Tan should go to Zhen prefecture to proclaim comfort and grant 1,000,000 strings.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Tan was sent to Zhenzhou with one million strings.

sentences.zh: 王澤所洽，天綱方恢，宥過釋冤，與人休泰。

translations.literal: Where royal grace penetrates, heaven's net is restored; pardon faults and release grievances, giving the people rest.
translations.idiomatic: Amnesty and rest were proclaimed throughout the circuit.

sentences.zh: 其管內見禁囚徒，罪無輕重，並宜釋放。

translations.literal: All prisoners now held in the circuit, regardless of crime's weight, should be released.
translations.idiomatic: All circuit prisoners were to be freed.

sentences.zh: 朕以武俊之勛勞，光於彞鼎；

translations.literal: I, because of Wujun's meritorious toil shining on the ritual vessels;
translations.idiomatic: For Wang Wujun's bronze-shining merit

sentences.zh: 士真之恭恪，繼被節旄。

translations.literal: Shizhen's respectful diligence continuing with the commander's banner —
translations.idiomatic: and Shizhen's loyal succession —

sentences.zh: 承宗感恩，亦克立效。

translations.literal: Chengzong in gratitude also could establish merit.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong too had proved loyal.

sentences.zh: 永言十代之宥，俾賜一門之榮。

translations.literal: Ever speaking of ten generations' grace, bestow one house's glory.
translations.idiomatic: Ten generations of grace would crown one clan.

sentences.zh: 承宗兄弟已授官爵，其承宗葬事亦差官監視，務令周厚。

translations.literal: Chengzong's brothers already received offices; his funeral also had officials assigned to oversee it with full care.
translations.idiomatic: His brothers were enfeoffed and his funeral overseen with care.

sentences.zh: 」丁未，封王承宗祖母李氏為晉國太夫人。

translations.literal: Thus ended the edict. On dingwei Wang Chengzong's grandmother Lady Li was enfeoffed Grand Lady of Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended the edict; on dingwei Lady Li was enfeoffed Grand Lady of Jin.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，田弘正奏王承元以今月九日領兵二千人赴鎮滑州。

translations.literal: On dingwei Wang Chengzong's grandmother Lady Li was enfeoffed Grand Lady of Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Lady Li was enfeoffed Grand Lady of Jin.

sentences.zh: 成德軍徵賞錢頗急，乃命柏耆先往諭之。

translations.literal: On xinhai Tian Hongzheng memorialized that Wang Chengyuan on the ninth of this month would lead 2,000 men to take up Hua prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Tian Hongzheng reported Chengyuan marching to Hua.

sentences.zh: 以華州刺史衛中行為陜州長史，充陜虢觀察使；

translations.literal: Chengde's demand for reward money was quite urgent; Bai Qi was ordered to go first and instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: Chengde pressed for reward cash; Bai Qi went ahead to calm them.

sentences.zh: 以宗正卿李翱為華州刺史、潼關防禦、鎮國軍使。

translations.literal: Hua observation commissioner Wei Zhongxing was made Shaan prefect and Shaan-Guo observer;
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhongxing took Shaan-Guo;

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上幸金吾將軍郭鏦城南莊，鏦以莊為獻。

translations.literal: Director of the Imperial Clan Li Ao was made Hua prefect, Tongguan defense commissioner, and Zhenguo army commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ao took Hua and Tongguan.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔曰：「朕來日暫往華清宮，至暮卻還。

translations.literal: On yimao the Emperor visited Gold Crow general Guo Cong's southern manor; Cong presented the manor.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Muzong accepted Guo Cong's estate as a gift.

sentences.zh: 」御史大夫李絳、常侍崔元略已下伏延英門切諫。

translations.literal: On wuwu an edict: "I shall temporarily go to Huaqing Palace tomorrow and return at dusk."
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Muzong announced a brief Huaqing visit.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「朕已成行，不煩章疏。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Li Jiang, Regular Attendant Cui Yuanlue, and below prostrated at Yanying Gate to remonstrate urgently.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiang and others remonstrated at Yanying Gate.

sentences.zh: 」諫官再三論列。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "My journey is already set — no need for memorials."
translations.idiomatic: Muzong said the trip was already decided.

sentences.zh: 是日，田弘正奏今月十六日入鎮州訖。

translations.literal: Remonstrance officials argued again and again.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrators pressed repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 己未，上由復道出城幸華清宮，左右中尉擗仗，六軍諸使、諸王、駙馬千餘人從，至晚還宮。

translations.literal: That day Tian Hongzheng memorialized that on the sixteenth of this month he entered Zhen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That day Tian Hongzheng reported entering Zhenzhou on the sixteenth.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，檢校司徒、兼太子少少師鄭餘慶卒。

translations.literal: On jiwei the Emperor left the palace for Huaqing by the secret route; the Left and Right commissioners cleared the way, over a thousand from the six armies, commissioners, princes, and sons-in-law followed, returning at night.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he slipped out to Huaqing with a thousand followers and returned at night.

sentences.zh: 以渭州刺史、涇原行營兵馬使、保定郡王郝玼為慶州刺史。

translations.literal: On guihai Acting Minister of Works and Crown Prince Junior Tutor Zheng Yuqing died.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Zheng Yuqing died.

sentences.zh: 將，深入吐蕃接戰，朝廷恐失勇將，故移之內地。

translations.literal: Wei prefect and Jingyuan frontier commander Hao Qi, Prince of Baoding, was made Qing prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Qi was moved inland to Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月己巳朔。

translations.literal: About to go deep into Tibet to fight, the court feared losing a brave general, hence moving him within the interior.
translations.idiomatic: The court feared losing him in deep Tibet raids.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，召故女學士宋若華妹若昭入宮掌文奏。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jisi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The twelfth month opened on jisi.

sentences.zh: 壬午，幸右軍擊鞠，遂畋於城西。

translations.literal: On wuyin the late female academician Song Ruohua's sister Ruozhao was summoned to the palace to manage documents.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Song Ruozhao entered palace service.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，前昭義軍節度使辛秘卒。

translations.literal: On renwu he visited the Right Army for cuju, then hunted west of the city.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he played cuju and hunted west of Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以庫部郎中、知制誥牛僧孺為御史中丞。

translations.literal: On bingxu former Zhaoyi military commissioner Xin Mi died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Xin Mi died.

sentences.zh: 嶺南奏崖州司戶參軍皇甫鎛卒。

translations.literal: On jichou Treasury Bureau director Niu Sengru was made Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Niu Sengru became vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以司門員外郎白居易為主客郎中、知制誥。

translations.literal: Lingnan reported Huangfu Bo, clerk of Yazhou, died.
translations.idiomatic: Lingnan reported Huangfu Bo's death in exile.

sentences.zh: 是歲，計戶帳，戶總二百三十七萬五千四百，口總一千五百七十六萬。

translations.literal: On bingshen Secretariat Gate Bureau external official Bai Juyi was made Guest Host director and drafting officer.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Bai Juyi entered the drafting office.

sentences.zh: 定、鹽、夏、劍南東西川、嶺南、黔中、邕管、容管、安南合九十七州不申戶帳。

translations.literal: This year household registers totaled 2,375,400 households and 15,760,000 persons.
translations.idiomatic: The census counted 2.38 million households and 15.76 million people.

sentences.zh: 長慶元年長慶元年正月己亥朔，上親薦獻太清宮、太廟。

translations.literal: Ding, Yan, Xia, eastern and western Sichuan, Lingnan, Qianzhong, Yong, Rong, and Annan — ninety-seven prefectures in all — did not file household registers.
translations.idiomatic: Ninety-seven frontier prefectures filed no census.

sentences.zh: 是日，法駕赴南郊。

translations.literal: Changqing 1 — In the first month of Changqing 1, on jihai new moon, the Emperor personally offered sacrifice at the Supreme Ultimate and Imperial Ancestor temples.
translations.idiomatic: Changqing 1 opened with sacrifices at the ancestral temples.

sentences.zh: 日抱珥，宰臣賀於前。

translations.literal: The sun showed halos; the chief ministers congratulated before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Solar halos appeared; ministers offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，祀昊天上帝於圓丘，即日還宮，御丹鳳樓，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On xinchou Heaven was sacrificed at the Round Mound; that day he returned to the palace, ascended Danfeng Tower, and proclaimed great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the suburban sacrifice ended with universal amnesty from Danfeng Tower.

sentences.zh: 改元長慶。

translations.literal: The era name was changed to Changqing.
translations.idiomatic: The reign was renamed Changqing.

sentences.zh: 內外文武及致仕官三品已上賜爵一及，四品已下加一階，陪位白身人賜勛兩轉，應緣大禮移仗宿衛御樓兵仗將士，普恩之外，賜勛爵有差。

translations.literal: Civil and military within and without, and retired officials of third rank and above, were granted one noble rank; fourth rank and below one step; commoners attending received two merit rotations; guards and soldiers beyond the general grace received graded merit and rank.
translations.idiomatic: Amnesty grants ranged by rank across the bureaucracy and army.

sentences.zh: 仍準舊例，賜錢物二十萬四千九百六十端匹。

translations.literal: Still per old precedent, 204,960 bolts of goods were granted.
translations.idiomatic: The court also distributed 204,960 bolts of goods.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，群臣於樓前稱賀。

translations.literal: When rites ended, ministers congratulated before the tower.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers congratulated before Danfeng Tower.

sentences.zh: 仗退，上朝太后於興慶宮。

translations.literal: When the guard withdrew, the Emperor attended the empress dowager at Xingqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He then visited the empress dowager at Xingqing.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，夏州節度使奏浙東、湖南等道防秋兵不習邊事，請留其兵甲，歸其人。

translations.literal: On renyin Xia military commissioner memorialized that Zhedong and Hunan frontier troops did not know border affairs — keep their armor, return the men.
translations.idiomatic: Xiazhou asked to keep armor but send home unskilled frontier drafts.

sentences.zh: 靈武節度使李聽奏請於淮南、忠武、武寧等道防秋兵中取三千人衣賜月糧，賜當道自募一千五百人馬驍勇者以備邊。

translations.literal: Lingwu military commissioner Li Ting memorialized asking to take 3,000 autumn-guard troops from Huainan, Zhongwu, and Wuning with clothing and monthly grain, and let the circuit recruit 1,500 swift horsemen for the border.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ting sought 3,000 borrowed troops and 1,500 local recruits.

sentences.zh: 仍令五十人為一社，每一馬死，社人共補之，馬永無闕。

translations.literal: Still order fifty men as one society — when one horse dies, society members together replace it, so horses are never lacking.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty-man horse societies would keep mounts supplied.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The throne agreed.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以河陽、懷節度使。

translations.literal: On guimao Heyang-Huai military commissioner —
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Heyang posts were reshuffled:

sentences.zh: 田布為涇州刺史，充四鎮北庭行營、涇原節度使；

translations.literal: Tian Bu was made Jing prefect and Four-Circuits Northern Court frontier commissioner and Jingyuan military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Tian Bu took Jingyuan;

sentences.zh: 以刑部尚書兼司農卿郭釗檢校戶部尚書、懷州刺史，充河陽三城、懷節度使。

translations.literal: Guo Zhao, Minister of Justice concurrent Minister of Agriculture, was made acting Revenue Minister and Huai prefect, Heyang-Sancheng-Huai military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zhao took Heyang;

sentences.zh: 以涇原節度使王潛檢校兵部尚書、江陵尹，充荊南節度使。

translations.literal: Jingyuan military commissioner Wang Qian was made acting War Minister and Jiangling intendant, Jingnan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Qian took Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，鄜坊節度使韓璀改名充。

translations.literal: On yisi Yan-Fang military commissioner Han Cui changed his name to Chong.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Han Cui renamed himself Chong.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以前檢校大理少卿、駙馬都尉劉士涇為太僕卿。

translations.literal: On jiyou former acting Dali vice director, Commandant of Sons-in-Law Liu Shijing was made Grand Master of the Stud.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Liu Shijing became Grand Master of the Stud.

sentences.zh: 給事中韋弘景、薛存慶封還詔書，上諭之曰：「士涇父昌有邊功，久為少列十餘年，又以尚雲安公主，朕欲加恩，制官敕下。

translations.literal: Drafting Attendant Wei Hongjing and Xue Cunqing returned the edict sealed; the Emperor explained: "Shijing's father Chang had frontier merit, long a vice director for more than ten years, and married Princess Yun'an — I wish to add grace; let the appointment proceed."
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrators returned Liu Shijing's appointment; Muzong overruled them citing frontier merit and marriage into the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 」制命始行。

translations.literal: The appointment then went forward.
translations.idiomatic: The appointment stood.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士、司勛員外郎李德裕上疏曰：「臣見國朝故事，駙馬國之親密，不合與朝廷要官往來，開元中止尤切。

translations.literal: Hanlin academician Li Deyu memorialized: "I see the dynastic precedent — sons-in-law are the state's intimates and should not traffic with important court offices; the Kaiyuan reign especially forbade it.
translations.idiomatic: Li Deyu asked to bar sons-in-law from visiting premiers:

sentences.zh: 近日駙馬多至宰相及要官宅，此輩無他才可以延接，唯是漏洩禁密、交通中外。

translations.literal: Recently sons-in-law often go to chief ministers' and key officials' houses — they have no talent to entertain, only leak forbidden secrets and connect inside and outside.
translations.idiomatic: "They leak secrets when they visit private houses.

sentences.zh: 伏望宣示駙馬等，今後有事任至中書見宰臣，此外不得至宰臣及臺省官私第。

translations.literal: I beg you proclaim to sons-in-law: hereafter if they have business they may come to the Secretariat to see the chief minister; beyond that they must not go to chief ministers' or censorial offices' private residences."
translations.idiomatic: Let them meet ministers only at the yamen." Thus ended the memorial's effect.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: On wuzi night a comet appeared in Wings.
translations.idiomatic: A comet blazed in the Wing mansion that night.

sentences.zh: 戊午夜，星孛于翼。

translations.literal: On renxu Xiao Mian, Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councillor, Duke of Xu, was made Right Vice Director — he had repeatedly memorialized begging to leave governance.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Xiao Mian left the council at his own request.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，制朝議大夫、守門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事徐國公蕭俯為尚書右僕射，累表乞罷政事故也。

translations.literal: On guihai Left Regular Cavalry Attendant Cui Yuanlue was made Qian prefect and Qianzhong observer.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Cui Yuanlue took Qianzhong.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以左散騎常侍崔元略為黔州刺史，充黔中觀察使。

translations.literal: On dingmao a comet appeared in Changchen, near the first star south of the Supreme Palace's western rampart.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao a comet neared the Supreme Palace rampart.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，星孛於長辰，近太微西垣南第一星。

translations.literal: On dingmao a comet appeared in Changchen, near the first star south of the Supreme Palace's western rampart.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao a comet neared the Supreme Palace rampart.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰朔。

translations.literal: Second month, wuchen new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The second month opened on wuchen.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以尚書右僕射蕭俯為吏部尚。

translations.literal: On guiyou Right Vice Director Xiao Mian was made Personnel Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Xiao Mian became personnel minister.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以檢校右僕射兼吏部尚書韓皋守右僕射。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Acting Right Vice Director and Personnel Minister Han Gao was ordered to keep the Right Vice Director post.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Han Gao kept the right vice directorship.

sentences.zh: 乙亥夜，太白犯昴。

translations.literal: On yihai night the White Planet invaded the Pleiades.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai night Venus crossed the Pleiades.

sentences.zh: 丙子，上觀雜伎樂於麟德殿，歡甚，顧謂給事中丁公著曰：「比聞外間公卿士庶時為歡宴，蓋時和民安，甚慰予心。

translations.literal: On bingzi the Emperor watched miscellaneous music at Linde Hall, greatly pleased, and said to Drafting Attendant Ding Gongzhu: "I hear that outside, dukes and commoners sometimes hold merry feasts — the times are harmonious and the people at peace; it greatly comforts my heart."
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi at Linde Hall Muzong praised widespread feasting to Ding Gongzhu.

sentences.zh: 」公著對曰：「誠有此事。

translations.literal: Gongzhu replied: "It is indeed so.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Gongzhu agreed it was true,

sentences.zh: 然臣之愚見，風俗如此，亦不足嘉。

translations.literal: Yet in my humble view, custom like this is not praiseworthy.
translations.idiomatic: but said such customs were no honor.

sentences.zh: 百司庶務，漸恐勞煩聖慮。

translations.literal: The hundred offices' many affairs gradually fear troubling the sacred mind.
translations.idiomatic: He warned that revelry would burden the emperor with neglected government.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「何至於是？

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "How could it reach that?"
translations.idiomatic: Muzong dismissed the worry.

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「夫賓宴之禮，務達誠敬，不繼以淫。

translations.literal: He replied: "Guest-feast ritual seeks sincere respect and does not continue with excess.
translations.idiomatic: Gongzhu cited ritual:

sentences.zh: 故詩人美『樂且有儀』。

translations.literal: Hence the Odes praise 'joy with measure.'
translations.idiomatic: "The Odes praise measured joy.

sentences.zh: 譏其屢舞。

translations.literal: They satirize repeated dancing.
translations.idiomatic: They mock repeated dancing.

sentences.zh: 前代名士良辰宴聚，或清談賦詩，投壺雅歌，以杯酌獻酬，不至於亂。

translations.literal: Former ages' famous gentlemen, on fine days gathering, sometimes pure talk and poetry, pitch-pot and elegant song, cups for exchange — not reaching disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient feasts stayed orderly with poetry and games.

sentences.zh: 國家自天寶已後，風俗奢靡，宴席以喧嘩沉湎為樂。

translations.literal: Since Tianbao the custom has been extravagant; banquets take noisy drunkenness as joy.
translations.idiomatic: Since Tianbao banquets had turned to noisy drunkenness.

sentences.zh: 而居重位、秉大權者，優雜倨肆於公吏之間，曾無愧恥。

translations.literal: Those holding heavy rank and great power perform mixed, arrogant antics among clerks, without shame.
translations.idiomatic: High officials now caroused shamelessly with clerks.

sentences.zh: 公私相效，漸以成俗。

translations.literal: Public and private imitate each other, gradually becoming custom.
translations.idiomatic: Public and private life imitated each other.

sentences.zh: 則是物務多廢。

translations.literal: Then affairs are widely neglected.
translations.idiomatic: Government was neglected.

sentences.zh: 獨聖心求理，安得不勞宸慮乎！

translations.literal: Only the sacred mind seeks order — how can it not weary the imperial concern!
translations.idiomatic: Only the throne still sought order — how could it not weary you!

sentences.zh: 陛下宜頒訓令，禁其過差，則天下幸甚。

translations.literal: Your Majesty should issue instruction forbidding excess, and the realm would be greatly fortunate."
translations.idiomatic: Issue prohibitions and the realm would be fortunate."

sentences.zh: 」時上荒於酒樂，公著因對諷之，頗深嘉納。

translations.literal: At the time the Emperor was dissolute in wine and music; Gongzhu used the reply to admonish, and the Emperor deeply approved.
translations.idiomatic: Muzong, deep in wine and music, took the rebuke well.

sentences.zh: 己卯，幽州節度使劉總奏請去位落發為僧。

translations.literal: On jimao Youzhou military commissioner Liu Zong memorialized asking to leave office, shave the head, and become a monk.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Liu Zong asked to abdicate and become a monk.

sentences.zh: 又請分割幽州所管郡縣為三道，請支三軍賞設錢一百萬貫。

translations.literal: He also asked to divide Youzhou's prefectures and counties into three circuits and requested 1,000,000 strings to reward the three armies.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed splitting Youzhou into three circuits and sought one million strings.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以中書侍郎、平章事段文昌檢校刑部尚書、同平章事、成都尹，充劍南西川節度等使，以朝散大夫、尚書戶部侍郎、知制誥、翰林學士、上柱國、建安縣開國男杜元穎守本官、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On renshen Vice Premier Duan Wenchang was made acting Justice Minister, Grand Councillor, Chengdu intendant, and western Sichuan military commissioner; Du Yuanying, Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, Vice Minister of Revenue, drafting officer, Hanlin academician, Duke of Jian, kept his posts and became Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Duan Wenchang went to western Sichuan and Du Yuanying joined the council.

sentences.zh: 以劍南西川節度使王播為刑部尚書，充鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: Western Sichuan military commissioner Wang Bo was made Justice Minister and Salt and Iron transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bo took Salt and Iron.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，天平軍節度使馬總奏：「當道見管軍士三萬三千五百人，從去年正月巳後，情願居農者放，逃戶者不捕。

translations.literal: On yiyou Ping'an Army military commissioner Ma Zong memorialized: "This circuit has 33,500 soldiers under command; from last year's first month onward, those wishing to farm are released, and runaway households are not pursued."
translations.idiomatic: Ma Zong asked to release soldiers who wished to farm.

sentences.zh: 」先是，平定河南，及王承元去鎮州，宰臣蕭俯等不顧遠圖，乃獻銷兵之議，請密詔天下軍鎮，每年限百人內破八人逃死，故總有是奏。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Henan was pacified and Wang Chengyuan left Zhen prefecture, Chief Minister Xiao Mian and others, not considering distant plans, offered a plan to reduce troops — secretly ordering all military commissioners yearly to count eight desertions or deaths per hundred, hence Zong's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: A secret quota on desertions had provoked Ma Zong's protest.

sentences.zh: 丁亥夜，月犯歲星，在尾十三度。

translations.literal: On dinghai night the moon invaded Jupiter in Tail's thirteenth degree.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai night the moon crossed Jupiter in Tail.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，寒食節，宴群臣於麟德殿，頒賜有差。

translations.literal: On xinmao Cold Food Festival, ministers were feasted at Linde Hall with graded gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Cold Food brought a Linde feast.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，刑部侍郎李建卒。

translations.literal: On renchen Vice Minister of Justice Li Jian died.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Li Jian died.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，九姓回紇毗伽保義可汗卒。

translations.literal: On guisi the Nine-Clan Uighur Pijia Protective-Faith Khan died.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the Uighur khan died.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉朔，浙東奏移明州於鄮縣置。

translations.literal: Third month, dingyou new moon — Zhedong memorialized moving Ming prefecture to Yin county.
translations.idiomatic: The third month opened with moving Mingzhou.

sentences.zh: 劉總進馬一萬五千匹。

translations.literal: Liu Zong presented 15,000 horses.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zong presented fifteen thousand horses.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，鄭滑節度使王承元祖母晉國太夫人李氏來朝，既見上，令朝太后於南內。

translations.literal: On jiachen Zheng-Hua military commissioner Wang Chengyuan's grandmother Grand Lady of Jin came to court; after seeing the Emperor she was directed to attend the empress dowager in the southern inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Lady Li of Jin visited both emperor and empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 丁未，宗正寺奏：「準貞元二十一年敕，宗子陪位，放五百七十人出身。

translations.literal: On dingwei the Imperial Clan Court memorialized: "Per the Zhenyuan 21 edict, clansmen attending received 570 offices; per this year's edict 300.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Clan asked for 200 more enfeoffments beyond this year's 300.

sentences.zh: 準今年敕放三百人。

translations.literal: Per this year's edict 300.
translations.idiomatic: This year's quota was only three hundred.

sentences.zh: 伏緣人數至多，不沾恩澤，乞降特恩，更放二百人出身。

translations.literal: I submit the number is so large many miss grace; beg special grace to release 200 more to office."
translations.idiomatic: They begged two hundred additional posts."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The throne agreed.

sentences.zh: 平盧薛平奏：海賊掠賣新羅人口於緣海郡縣，請嚴加禁絕，俾異俗懷恩。

translations.literal: Pinglu Xue Ping memorialized: pirates sold Silla people along coastal prefectures — strictly forbid it so foreign peoples feel grace.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Ping asked to stop selling captured Silla subjects.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The throne agreed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，罷京西、京北和糴使，擾人故也。

translations.literal: On wushen the western and northern capital grain-purchase commissioners were abolished for harassing the people.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen capital grain commissioners were abolished as oppressive.

sentences.zh: 罷河北榷鹽法，許維計課利都數付榷鹽院。

translations.literal: The Hebei salt monopoly law was abolished; estimated annual profit totals were given to the monopoly office.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei salt monopoly rules were relaxed to fixed quotas.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以左丞韋綬為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On gengxu Left Vice Director Wei Shou was made Rituals Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Wei Shou became rituals minister.

sentences.zh: 是夜，太白近五車。

translations.literal: That night the White Planet neared the Five Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: That night Venus neared the Five Chariots.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命給事中韋弘慶充幽州宣慰使，左拾遣狄兼謨副之。

translations.literal: On xinhai Drafting Attendant Wei Hongjing was made Youzhou comfort commissioner; Left Reminder Di Jianmo was deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Wei Hongjing and Di Jianmo were sent to comfort Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 鹽鐵使王播奏江淮鹽估每斗加五十文，兼舊三百文。

translations.literal: Salt and Iron Commissioner Wang Bo memorialized: on the Jiang-Huai salt price add fifty cash per dou, making 350 cash with the old 300.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bo raised the Jiang-Huai salt price by fifty cash per dou.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以幽州盧龍軍節度副大使、知節度事、押奚、契丹兩蕃經略等使、檢校司空、同中書門下平章事、楚國公劉總可檢校司徒、兼侍中、天平軍節度、鄆曹濮等州觀察等使。

translations.literal: On guichou Youzhou deputy military commissioner Liu Zong was made acting Minister of Works, concurrent Vice Director, Duke of Chu, and Ping'an Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Liu Zong was formally shifted to Ping'an Army.

sentences.zh: 以宣武軍節度使。

translations.literal: Xuanwu Army military commissioner —
translations.idiomatic: Xuanwu posts were reassigned:

sentences.zh: 檢校右僕射、同平章事張弘靖為檢校司空、同平章事、兼幽州大都督府長史，充幽州盧龍軍節度使。

translations.literal: Acting Right Vice Director Zhang Hongjing was made acting Minister of Works, Grand Councillor, chief of You prefecture, and Youzhou-Lulong military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hongjing took Youzhou at Liu Zong's request.

sentences.zh: 從劉總所奏故也。

translations.literal: Following Liu Zong's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: This followed Liu Zong's abdication plan.

sentences.zh: 以鳳翔節度使李願檢校司空、汴州刺史，充宣武軍節度使；

translations.literal: Fengxiang military commissioner Li Yuan was made acting Minister of Works, Bian prefect, and Xuanwu military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Li Yuan took Xuanwu;

sentences.zh: 以邠寧節度使李光顏為鳳翔尹，依前檢校司空、平章事，充鳳翔隴右節度使。

translations.literal: Bin-Ning military commissioner Li Guangyan was made Fengxiang intendant, keeping acting Minister of Works and Grand Councillor, and Fengxiang-Longyou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangyan took Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 以右衛大將軍高霞寓檢校工部尚書、邠州刺史、充邠寧節度使。

translations.literal: Right Guard Grand General Gao Xiayu was made acting Works Minister, Bin prefect, and Bin-Ning military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Xiayu took Bin-Ning.

sentences.zh: 諫官上疏論霞寓敗軍左謫，未宜拜方鎮。

translations.literal: Remonstrance officials memorialized that Xiayu had been demoted for defeat and should not receive a commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrators said Gao Xiayu was unfit after defeat.

sentences.zh: 不從。

translations.literal: Not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Muzong ignored them.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以權知京兆尹盧士玫為瀛州刺史，充瀛莫等州團練觀察使。

translations.literal: On yimao Acting Jingzhao intendant Lu Shimei was made Ying prefect and Ying-Mo regimental observer.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Lu Shimei took Ying-Mo per Liu Zong's partition plan.

sentences.zh: 從劉總奏析置也。

translations.literal: Following Liu Zong's memorial to divide and establish.
translations.idiomatic: The post followed Liu Zong's three-circuit scheme.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，制：「劉總已極上臺，仍移重鎮，兄弟子侄，各授官榮，大將賓僚，亦宜超擢。

translations.literal: On dingsi a decree: "Liu Zong has reached the highest terrace yet still moves to a heavy commandery; brothers, sons, and nephews each receive rank; great generals and guests should also be promoted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi a decree rewarded Liu Zong's household and army:

sentences.zh: 幽州百姓給復一年，賜三軍賞設錢一百萬貫。

translations.literal: Youzhou commoners receive one year's tax remission; grant the three armies 1,000,000 strings for rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou got a tax holiday and one million strings for the troops.

sentences.zh: 令宣慰使薛存慶與弘靖計會支給。

translations.literal: Order comfort commissioner Xue Cunqing and Hongjing to calculate and disburse."
translations.idiomatic: Xue Cunqing and Hongjing would disburse the funds." Thus ended the edict.

sentences.zh: 」戊午，封皇弟憬為鄜王，悅為瓊王，恂為沔王，懌為婺王，愔為茂王，怡為光王，協為淄王，憺為衢王，惋為澶王；

translations.literal: On wuwu younger brothers Jing was enfeoffed Prince of Fen, Yue Prince of Qiong, Xun Prince of Mian, Yi Prince of Wu, Yin Prince of Mao, Yi Prince of Guang, Xie Prince of Zi, Tan Prince of Qu, Wan Prince of Chan;
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu nine younger brothers received princely titles;

sentences.zh: 皇子湛為景王，涵為江王，湊為漳王，溶為安王，瀍為潁王。

translations.literal: Princes Zhan Prince of Jing, Han Prince of Jiang, Cou Prince of Zhang, Rong Prince of An, Chan Prince of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: five sons also became princes.

sentences.zh: 以兵部侍郎柳公綽為京兆尹、兼御史大夫。

translations.literal: Vice War Minister Liu Gongchuo was made Jingzhao intendant and concurrent Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Gongchuo became Jingzhao intendant.

sentences.zh: 己未，以屯田員外郎李德裕為考功郎中，左補闕李紳為司勳員外郎，並依前知制誥、翰林學士。

translations.literal: On jiwei Field Bureau external official Li Deyu was made Director of Merit; Left Reminder Li Shen was made Merit Bureau external official — both kept drafting and Hanlin posts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Li Deyu and Li Shen were promoted within the drafting office.

sentences.zh: 勅今年錢徽下進士及第鄭朗等一十四人，宜令中書舍人王起、主客郎中知制誥白居易等重試以聞。

translations.literal: An order: this year's jinshi graduates Zheng Lang and thirteen others should be re-examined by Secretariat drafter Wang Qi and Guest Host drafting officer Bai Juyi and reported.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered a re-examination of Qian Hui's jinshi picks.

sentences.zh: 甲子，劉總請以私第為佛寺，乃遣中使賜寺額曰「報恩」。

translations.literal: On jiazi Liu Zong asked to make his private residence a Buddhist temple; a palace envoy granted the plaque name "Repaying Grace."
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Liu Zong's house became the Repaying Grace temple.

sentences.zh: 幽州奏劉總堅請為僧，又賜以僧衣，賜號大覺。

translations.literal: Youzhou memorialized Liu Zong firmly asked to become a monk; monk robes were again granted and the religious name Great Awakening given.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou reported Liu Zong took the name Great Awakening.

sentences.zh: 總是夜遁去，幽州人不知所之。

translations.literal: That night Zong fled; the Youzhou people did not know where.
translations.idiomatic: That night Liu Zong vanished.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以漳州刺史韓泰為郴州刺史，汀州刺史韓曄為永州刺史，循州刺史陳諫為道州刺史，量移也。

translations.literal: On yichou Zhang prefect Han Tai was made Chen prefect, Ting prefect Han Ye Yong prefect, Xun prefect Chen Jian Dao prefect — transferred in grade.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou four exiled officials were moved to lesser posts.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅朔，授劉總弟約及總男等一十一人官，內五人為刺史，余朝班環衛。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, bingyin new moon — Liu Zong's brother Yue and Zong's sons and others, eleven persons, received offices; five became prefects, the rest palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth month opened with offices for Liu Zong's kin.

sentences.zh: 庚午，易定奏劉總已為僧，三月二十七日卒於當道界，贈太尉。

translations.literal: On gengwu Yi-Ding reported Liu Zong had become a monk and died on the twenty-seventh of the third month on the circuit border; posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Yi-Ding reported Liu Zong's death as a monk.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，秘書監蔣乂卒。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Secretariat Director Jiang Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Jiang Yi died.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以前天平軍節度使馬總復為天平節度使。

translations.literal: On bingzi former Ping'an Army military commissioner Ma Zong again became Ping'an military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Ma Zong returned to Ping'an.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔：「國家設文學之科，本求才實，苟容僥倖，則異至公。

translations.literal: On dingchou an edict: "The state establishes literary examinations to seek real talent; if chance is tolerated, fairness differs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Muzong condemned the jinshi scandal:

sentences.zh: 訪聞近日浮薄之徒，扇為朋黨，謂之關節，干擾主司，每歲策名，無不先定。

translations.literal: I hear recently shallow men stir faction, called 'gate-nodes,' disturbing the chief examiner; each year's listed names are fixed beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: "Exam factions fixed outcomes before testing.

sentences.zh: 永言敗俗，深用興懷。

translations.literal: Ever speaking of corrupting custom, I deeply feel indignation.
