translations.idiomatic: The court was outraged.

sentences.zh: 鄭朗等昨令重試，意在精覆藝能，不於異常之中，固求深僻題目，貴令所試成就，以觀學藝淺深。

translations.literal: Zheng Lang and others were re-tested to scrutinize ability, not to seek obscure topics in the unusual, but to see accomplishment and depth of learning.
translations.idiomatic: The re-test sought real learning, not trick questions.

sentences.zh: 孤竹管是祭天之樂，出於《周禮》正經，閱其呈試之文，都不知其本事。

translations.literal: The lone-bamboo pipe is music for sacrificing Heaven, from the orthodox Zhou Rites; reading their submitted texts, none knew its basis.
translations.idiomatic: Graduates could not explain a Zhou Rites music question.

sentences.zh: 辭律鄙淺，蕪累何多。

translations.literal: Their prose was shallow and piled with errors.
translations.idiomatic: Their essays were crude and error-filled.

sentences.zh: 亦令宣示錢徵，庶其深自懷愧。

translations.literal: Also order Qian Hui shown it so he deeply feels shame.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Hui was shamed before the court.

sentences.zh: 誠宜盡棄，以警將來。

translations.literal: Truly they should all be rejected to warn the future.
translations.idiomatic: All should have been failed.

sentences.zh: 但以四海無虞，人心方泰，用弘寬假，式示殊恩。

translations.literal: But the four seas are untroubled and hearts at peace — use broad mercy and show special grace.
translations.idiomatic: Yet peace allowed mercy.

sentences.zh: 孔溫業、趙存約、竇洵直所試粗通，與及第；

translations.literal: Kong Wenye, Zhao Cunyue, and Dou Xunzhi's tests were roughly passable and passed;
translations.idiomatic: Three passed marginally;

sentences.zh: 盧公亮等十一人可落下。

translations.literal: Lu Gongliang and eleven others were to fail.
translations.idiomatic: eleven including Lu Gongliang failed.

sentences.zh: 自今後禮部舉人，宜准開元二十五年敕，及第人所試雜文並策，送中書門下詳覆。

translations.literal: Hereafter Rituals Bureau candidates' examination essays and policy answers should be sent to the Secretariat for detailed review per the Kaiyuan 25 edict."
translations.idiomatic: Future jinshi papers would go to the Secretariat for review." Thus ended the edict.

sentences.zh: 」貶禮部侍郎錢徽為江州刺史，中書舍人李宗閔為劍州刺史，右補闕楊汝士為開州開江令。

translations.literal: Rituals Vice Minister Qian Hui was demoted to Jiang prefect; Secretariat drafter Li Zongmin to Jian prefect; Right Reminder Yang Rushi to Kaijiang magistrate of Kaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Hui, Li Zongmin, and Yang Rushi were punished.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，宰臣崔植、杜元穎奏請，坐日所有群臣獻替，事關禮體，便隨日撰錄，號為《聖政紀》，歲終付史館。

translations.literal: On wuyin chief ministers Cui Zhi and Du Yuanying memorialized: on audience days record all ministers' policy proposals touching ritual and send yearly to the History Office as "Record of Sagely Governance."
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Cui Zhi proposed a Record of Sagely Governance.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The throne agreed.

sentences.zh: 事亦不行。

translations.literal: The matter also was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The project never materialized.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，正衙命使冊九姓回紇為登羅羽錄沒密施句主錄毗伽可汗。

translations.literal: On bingxu at regular court an envoy installed the Nine-Clan Uighur as Dengluo Yuluolu Moimi Shiju Zhulu Pijia Protective-Faith Khan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu a new Uighur khan was enthroned.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以衡州刺史令狐楚為郢州刺史，吉州司馬孟簡為睦州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinmao Heng prefect Linghu Chu was made E prefect; Jizhou Sima Meng Jian was made Mu prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Linghu Chu and Meng Jian were reassigned.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔百辟卿士宜各徇公，勿為朋黨。

translations.literal: On renchen an edict: the hundred officials and scholars should each pursue the public good and not form factions.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the court forbade factionalism.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以張弘靖入幽州，受朝賀。

translations.literal: On jiawu Zhang Hongjing entered Youzhou and received court congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Zhang Hongjing entered Youzhou to acclaim.

sentences.zh: 中書門下奏燕、薊八州平，准禮宜告陵廟，從之。

translations.literal: Secretariat and Department memorialized: the eight Yan-Ji prefectures were pacified — per ritual the imperial tombs should be notified.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat asked to notify the tombs of Yan-Ji pacification.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申朔。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The throne agreed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以刑獄淹滯，立程：凡大事，大理寺三十五日詳斷訖，申刑部，三十日聞奏；

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingchen new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth month opened on bingchen.

sentences.zh: 中事，大理寺三十日，刑部二十五日；

translations.literal: On wuxu because criminal cases lagged, a schedule was set: great cases — Dali thirty-five days to judge and finish, then Justice thirty days to report;
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Muzong set judicial deadlines for great, middle, and small cases;

sentences.zh: 小事，大理寺二十五日，刑部二十日。

translations.literal: middle cases — Dali thirty days, Justice twenty-five;
translations.idiomatic: middle cases thirty and twenty-five days;

sentences.zh: 所斷罪二十件已上為大，十件已上為中，十件已下為小。

translations.literal: small cases — Dali twenty-five days, Justice twenty.
translations.idiomatic: small cases twenty-five and twenty.

sentences.zh: 刑部四覆官、大理六丞每月常須二十日入省寺，其廚料令戶部加給。

translations.literal: Judged crimes of twenty items and above are great, ten and above middle, below ten small.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty or more counts were great, ten middle, fewer small.

sentences.zh: 從中丞牛僧孺奏也。

translations.literal: Justice four review officers and Dali six assistants must enter the offices twenty days monthly; kitchen funds increased by Revenue — following Vice Censor Niu Sengru's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Review officers got more kitchen funds per Niu Sengru's plan.

sentences.zh: 己亥，貶考功員外郎李渤為虔州刺史，以前書宰相考辭太過，宰相杜元穎等奏貶之。

translations.literal: On jihai Merit Bureau external official Li Bo was demoted to Qian prefect — earlier he had praised the chief ministers too highly in examination comments; Du Yuanying and others memorialized for demotion.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Li Bo was exiled for flattering the premiers in exam reports.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，幽州大將李參已下十八人並為刺史及諸衛將軍。

translations.literal: On guimao eighteen Youzhou great generals including Li Can were made prefects and guard generals.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao eighteen Youzhou generals received capital posts.

sentences.zh: 己酉，右散騎常侍致仕柳登卒。

translations.literal: On jiyou retired Right Regular Cavalry Attendant Liu Deng died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Liu Deng died in retirement.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，造百尺樓于宮中。

translations.literal: On xinhai a hundred-chi tower was built in the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai a hundred-chi tower rose in the palace.

sentences.zh: 壬子，加茶榷，舊額百文，更加五十文，從王播奏。

translations.literal: On renzi tea monopoly was increased — old quota 100 cash, now add fifty, following Wang Bo's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the tea tax rose fifty cash per Wang Bo.

sentences.zh: 拾遺李玨上參論其不可，疏奏不報。

translations.literal: Remonstrator Li Jue memorialized it should not be done; the memorial was not answered.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jue protested in vain.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，建王審薨。

translations.literal: On bingchen Prince Shen died.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Shen died on bingchen.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，滄州先置景州于弓高縣，置歸化縣於福城草市，並宜停廢。

translations.literal: On dingsi Cangzhou's earlier Jing prefecture at Gonggao county and Guihua county at Fucheng market were both abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi two Cangzhou counties were abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，幽州宣慰使給事中薛存慶卒於鎮州。

translations.literal: On renxu Youzhou comfort commissioner Xue Cunqing died at Zhen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Xue Cunqing died in Youzhou service.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，敕先置溵州於郾城，宜廢；

translations.literal: On guihai the earlier Yin prefecture at Yancheng was abolished;
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Yin prefecture was abolished;

sentences.zh: 其郾城上蔡、西平、遂平兩縣復隸蔡州。

translations.literal: Yancheng, Shangcai, Xiping, and Suiping two counties returned to Cai prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: its counties reverted to Cai prefecture.

sentences.zh: 皇妹太和公主出降回紇登羅骨沒施合毗伽可汗。

translations.literal: The imperial sister Princess Taihe was sent to marry the Uighur Dengluo Gumu Shijia Pijia Protective-Faith Khan.
translations.idiomatic: Princess Taihe departed to marry the Uighur khan.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命金吾大將軍胡證充送公主入回紇使，兼冊可汗。

translations.literal: On jiazi Gold Crow Grand General Hu Zheng was made envoy escorting the princess into Uighur lands and concurrently enfeoffing the khan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Hu Zheng escorted the princess and enthroned the khan.

sentences.zh: 又乙太府卿李銳為入回紇婚禮使。

translations.literal: Also Yi Grand Master of the Stud Li Rui was made marriage envoy to Uighur.
translations.idiomatic: Li Rui served as marriage envoy.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑朔。

translations.literal: Sixth month, yichou new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth month opened on yichou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，吐蕃犯青塞堡。

translations.literal: On xinwei Tibet raided Qing Fortress.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet raided Qing Fortress on xinwei.

sentences.zh: 甲申，賜御史中丞牛僧孺金紫。

translations.literal: On jiashen Vice Censor-in-Chief Niu Sengru was granted gold-purple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Niu Sengru received gold-purple.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙未朔。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, yiwei new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh month opened on yiwei.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，月掩房次相。

translations.literal: On renyin the moon occulted the Room's second star.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the moon eclipsed a Room star.

sentences.zh: 壬子，群臣上尊號曰文武孝德皇帝。

translations.literal: On renzi the ministers advanced the honorific Civil-Martial Filial Virtue Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi ministers offered the honorific Civil-Martial Filial Virtue.

sentences.zh: 是日，上受冊于宣政殿，禮畢，禦丹鳳樓，大赦天下。

translations.literal: That day the Emperor received the seal at Xuanzheng Hall; when rites ended he ascended Danfeng Tower and proclaimed great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: That day Muzong took the honorific and proclaimed amnesty.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，幽州監軍使奏：「今月十日軍亂，囚節度使張弘靖別館。

translations.literal: On jiayin Youzhou military commissioner reported: on the tenth of this month the army mutinied, imprisoning military commissioner Zhang Hongjing in a separate lodge.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Youzhou mutinied and seized Zhang Hongjing.

sentences.zh: 害判官韋雍、張宗元、崔仲卿、鄭塤。

translations.literal: They killed judges Wei Yong, Zhang Zongyuan, Cui Zhongqing, and Zheng Kan.
translations.idiomatic: Four staff were murdered.

sentences.zh: 軍人取硃滔子洄為留後。

translations.literal: Soldiers took Zhu Tao's son Hui as acting commander.
translations.idiomatic: The troops installed Zhu Hui as acting commander.

sentences.zh: 」丁巳，貶張弘靖為太子賓客分司。

translations.literal: On dingsi Zhang Hongjing was demoted to crown prince mentor at eastern Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Zhang Hongjing was demoted.

sentences.zh: 己未，再貶弘靖為吉州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiwei Hongjing was demoted again to Ji prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he was sent to Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 硃洄自以年老，令軍人立其子無融為留後。

translations.literal: Zhu Hui, finding himself old, had the army install his son Wurong as acting commander.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Hui yielded to his son Wurong.

sentences.zh: 初，劉總歸朝，籍其軍中素難制者送歸闕庭，克融在籍中。

translations.literal: Earlier when Liu Zong came to court he registered hard-to-control officers and sent them to the capital; Ke Rong was on the register.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zong had sent unruly officers including Ke Rong to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 宰相崔植、杜元穎素不知兵，心無遠慮，謂兩河無虞，不復禍亂矣，遂奏劉總所籍大將並勒還幽州，故克融為亂，復失河北矣。

translations.literal: Chief ministers Cui Zhi and Du Yuanying did not know warfare and lacked far sight, thinking the two Hebei circuits secure and no longer prone to rebellion, so memorialized to send Liu Zong's registered great generals back to Youzhou — hence Ke Rong rebelled and Hebei was lost again.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Zhi and Du Yuanying sent the officers back, restoring Hebei rebellion under Ke Rong.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以昭義軍節度使劉悟檢校司空，兼幽州大都督府長史，充幽州盧龍軍節度副大使、知節度事。

translations.literal: On gengshen Zhaoyi military commissioner Liu Wu was made acting Minister of Works, concurrent chief of You prefecture, Youzhou-Lulong deputy military commissioner managing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Liu Wu was rushed to Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 以國子祭酒韓愈為兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: National University Chancellor Han Yu was made Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Han Yu was made vice war minister.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太和長色主發赴回紇，上以半仗禦通化門臨送，群臣班于章敬寺前。

translations.literal: On xinyou Princess Taihe set out for Uighur; the Emperor with half the guard saw her off at Tonghua Gate; ministers lined up before Zhangjing Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Muzong half-escorted Princess Taihe to the frontier.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子朔。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiazi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth month opened on jiazi.

sentences.zh: 己巳，鎮州監軍宋惟澄奏：七月二十八日夜軍亂，節度使田弘正並家屬將佐三百餘口並遇害。

translations.literal: On jisi Zhen prefecture commissioner Song Weicheng memorialized: on the night of the twenty-eighth of the seventh month the army mutinied; military commissioner Tian Hongzheng and over three hundred family and staff were all killed.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Zhenzhou reported Tian Hongzheng and three hundred kin slaughtered.

sentences.zh: 軍人推衙將王廷湊為留後。

translations.literal: Soldiers elevated yamen officer Wang Tingcou as acting commander.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Tingcou was made acting commander.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以左金吾將軍楊元卿為涇州刺史，充四鎮北庭行軍、涇原節度使。

translations.literal: On xinwei Left Gold Crow general Yang Yuanqing was made Jing prefect and Four-Circuits Northern Court frontier commissioner and Jingyuan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Yang Yuanqing took Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 敕公卿大臣至中書議幽、鎮討伐之謀。

translations.literal: An order: dukes and great ministers should come to the Secretariat to discuss You-Zhen suppression.
translations.idiomatic: The court convened to plan war on You and Zhen.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，王廷湊遣盜殺冀州刺史王進岌，據其郡。

translations.literal: On guiyou Wang Tingcou sent assassins to kill Ji prefect Wang Jinki and seize the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Wang Tingcou murdered Ji prefect Wang Jinki.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以前涇原節度使田布起復檢校工部尚書，兼魏州大都督府長史，充魏博節度使。

translations.literal: On yihai former Jingyuan military commissioner Tian Bu was recalled to acting Works Minister, concurrent chief of Wei prefecture, and Weibo military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Tian Bu was sent to Weibo in mourning dress.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以深州刺史、本州團練使牛元翼充深冀節度使。

translations.literal: On jimao Shen prefect and regimental commissioner Niu Yuanyi was made Shen-Ji military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Niu Yuanyi defended Shen-Ji.

sentences.zh: 辛巳夜，太白近軒轅左角。

translations.literal: On xinsi night the White Planet neared the left horn of the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi night Venus neared the Chariot's horn.

sentences.zh: 冀州刺史吳暐潛為幽州兵所逐。

translations.literal: Ji prefect Wu Yun was secretly driven out by Youzhou troops.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Yun was expelled from Jizhou by Youzhou troops.

sentences.zh: 瀛州兵亂，囚觀察使盧士玫。

translations.literal: Ying prefecture mutinied, imprisoning observer Lu Shimei.
translations.idiomatic: Yingzhou mutinied and seized Lu Shimei.

sentences.zh: 瀛州尋為幽州兵所據。

translations.literal: Ying prefecture was soon taken by Youzhou troops.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou troops then seized Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以河東節度裴度充幽、鎮兩道招撫使。

translations.literal: On yichou, Hedong military commissioner Pei Du was made commissioner to pacify You and Zhen circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Pei Du was charged with pacifying You and Zhen.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以建州刺史李景儉為諫議大夫。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Jianzhou prefect Li Jingjian was made Remonstrating Doctor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Li Jingjian entered the remonstrance bureau.

sentences.zh: 壬辰夜，太白近太微西垣。

translations.literal: On renchen night, Venus drew near the Western Enclosure of the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Venus neared the Supreme Palace's western wall on renchen night.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，鎮州出兵圍深州。

translations.literal: On guisi, Zhenzhou troops went out and besieged Shenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Zhenzhou forces besieged Shenzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午朔。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiawu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The ninth month opened on jiawu.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，廢興州鳴水縣。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Mingshui county of Xingzhou was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Mingshui county was abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊戌夜，太白近太微右執法。

translations.literal: On wuxu night, Venus drew near the Right Enforcement star of the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu night Venus neared the Supreme Palace's Right Enforcement star.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，大雨震霆。

translations.literal: On renyin, great rain with thunder and lightning.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin a thunderstorm struck.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，相州兵亂，殺刺史邢楚。

translations.literal: On yisi, Xiangzhou troops mutinied and killed prefect Xing Chu.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Xiangzhou mutineers killed their prefect.

sentences.zh: 丙午，令內常侍段文政監領鄭滑、河東、許三道兵，救援深州。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Palace Attendant Duan Wenzheng was ordered to supervise Zheng-Hua, Hedong, and Xu circuit troops to rescue Shenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Duan Wenzheng took command of relief forces for Shenzhou.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃請盟，許之。

translations.literal: Tibet requested alliance — it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet's request for alliance was accepted.

sentences.zh: 辛亥夜，月近天關。

translations.literal: On xinhai night, the moon drew near the Celestial Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai night the moon neared the Celestial Pass.

sentences.zh: 壬子，幽州賊掠易州淶水、遂城、滿城。

translations.literal: On renzi, Youzhou rebels plundered Lai River, Suicheng, and Mancheng in Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Youzhou raiders struck three Yizhou counties.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以前魏博節度使李醖為太子少保。

translations.literal: On guichou, former Weibo military commissioner Li Yun was made Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Li Yun became crown prince tutor.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，魏博節度使田布奏，出師五千赴貝州行營。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Weibo military commissioner Tian Bu memorialized that he had sent five thousand troops to the Beizhou field camp.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Tian Bu reported five thousand men sent to Beizhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子朔。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jiazi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The tenth month opened on jiazi.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，太中大夫、守刑部尚書、騎都尉王播可中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事，依前充鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Grand Master of the Palace, acting Minister of Justice, Cavalry Commandant Wang Bo was made Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councillor, continuing as Salt and Iron Transport Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Wang Bo joined the council while keeping Salt and Iron.

sentences.zh: 以河東節度使裴度充鎮州四面行營都招討使。

translations.literal: Hedong military commissioner Pei Du was made commander-in-chief of the Zhenzhou encirclement campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Du took overall command against Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 以左領軍衛大將軍杜叔良充深、冀諸道行營節度使。

translations.literal: Left Leading Army Guard Grand General Du Shuliang was made military commissioner of the Shen-Ji field command.
translations.idiomatic: Du Shuliang was named to lead the Shen-Ji field army.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以深、冀節度使牛元翼為鎮州大都督府長史，充成德軍節度、鎮冀深趙等州節度使。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Shen-Ji military commissioner Niu Yuanyi was made Administrator of Zhenzhou metropolitan prefecture, Chengde military commissioner, and military commissioner of Zhen, Ji, Shen, and Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Niu Yuanyi was installed as Chengde military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以中書舍人、知貢舉王起為禮部侍郎，兵部郎中楊嗣復為庫部郎中、知制誥。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Secretariat Drafter and examination supervisor Wang Qi was made Minister of Rites; War Bureau Director Yang Sifu was made Treasury Bureau Director and edict drafter.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Wang Qi took Rites and Yang Sifu joined the drafting office.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以東都留守鄭絪為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On renshen, Eastern Capital intendant Zheng Yin was made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Zheng Yin became Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 以吏部尚書李絳檢校右僕射，判東都尚書省事、東都留守、都畿防禦使。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Li Jiang was made acting Right Vice Director, judging Eastern Capital Secretariat affairs, Eastern Capital intendant, and Capital Region defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiang was posted to the Eastern Capital as acting vice director.

sentences.zh: 以工部尚書丁公著檢校左散騎常侍，兼越州刺史、御史中丞，充浙東觀察使。

translations.literal: Works Minister Ding Gongzhu was made acting Left Regular Cavalry Attendant, concurrent Yuezhou prefect and Censor-in-Chief, and Zhedong observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Gongzhu went to Zhedong on concurrent posts.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，沂州刺史王智興為武寧軍節度副使。

translations.literal: On yihai, Yizhou prefect Wang Zhixing was made Wuning army deputy military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Wang Zhixing became Wuning deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，裴度奏，自將兵取故關路進討。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Pei Du memorialized that he would personally lead troops by the old Guan road to advance the attack.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Pei Du pledged to lead the advance by the Guan road.

sentences.zh: 硃克融兵寇蔚州。

translations.literal: Zhu Kerong's troops raided Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Kerong struck Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，王廷湊兵寇貝州。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Wang Tingcou's troops raided Beizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Wang Tingcou attacked Beizhou.

sentences.zh: 易州刺史柳公濟奏于白石嶺破燕軍三千。

translations.literal: Yizhou prefect Liu Gongji memorialized that at Baishiling he had broken three thousand Yan troops.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Gongji reported crushing three thousand Yan troops at Baishiling.

sentences.zh: 滄州烏重胤奏，于饒陽破賊。

translations.literal: Cangzhou's Wu Chongyin memorialized that at Raoyang he had broken the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Chongyin reported a victory at Raoyang.

sentences.zh: 工部尚書韋貫之卒。

translations.literal: Works Minister Wei Guanzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Guanzhi died.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以尚書主客郎中、知制誥白居易為中書舍人。

translations.literal: On renwu, Secretariat Master of Guests Director and edict drafter Bai Juyi was made Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Bai Juyi was promoted to drafter.

sentences.zh: 河東節度使裴度三上章，論翰林學士元稹與中官知樞密魏弘簡交通，傾亂朝政。

translations.literal: Hedong military commissioner Pei Du thrice submitted memorials charging Hanlin academician Yuan Zhen and Palace Secretariat eunuch Wei Hongjian with collusion that overturned court governance.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Du thrice accused Yuan Zhen and eunuch Wei Hongjian of corrupting the court.

sentences.zh: 以稹為工部侍郎，罷學士。

translations.literal: Yuan Zhen was made Works Vice Minister and removed from the Hanlin.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zhen left the Hanlin for Works.

sentences.zh: 弘簡為弓箭庫使。

translations.literal: Hongjian was made Bow and Arrow Store commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Hongjian was sent to the bow store.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以京兆尹、御史大夫柳公綽為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Jingzhao intendant and Censor-in-Chief Liu Gongchuo was made Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Liu Gongchuo became vice personnel minister.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以深冀行營節度使杜叔良為滄州刺史、橫海軍節度使，以代烏重胤；

translations.literal: On bingxu, Shen-Ji field commissioner Du Shuliang was made Cangzhou prefect and Henghai military commissioner, replacing Wu Chongyin;
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Du Shuliang replaced Wu Chongyin at Cangzhou;

sentences.zh: 授重胤檢校司徒、興元尹，充山南西道節度使。

translations.literal: Chongyin was made acting Minister of Works, Xingyuan intendant, and Shannan West military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Chongyin was transferred to Shannan West.

sentences.zh: 時上急於誅賊，杜叔良出征日面辭，奏云：「臣必旦夕破賊。

translations.literal: The Emperor was urgent to destroy the rebels; on the day Du Shuliang set out he faced the throne and memorialized: "Your servant will break the rebels within days."
translations.idiomatic: Du Shuliang promised a swift victory as he departed.

sentences.zh: 」重胤善將知兵，以賊勢未可卒平，用兵稍緩，故有是拜。

translations.literal: Chongyin was skilled at command and knew warfare; because rebel strength could not be suddenly pacified, he used troops somewhat slowly — hence this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Chongyin's deliberate pace had cost him the command.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，前浙東觀察使薛戎卒。

translations.literal: On dinghai, former Zhedong observation commissioner Xue Rong died.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Xue Rong died.

sentences.zh: 戊子，魏博田布奏，自率全師進討。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Weibo's Tian Bu memorialized that he personally led the full army to advance the attack.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Tian Bu led Weibo's full force forward.

sentences.zh: 太子少保李醖卒。

translations.literal: Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince Li Yun died.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yun died.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以戶部侍郎、判度支崔為工部尚書、判度支。

translations.literal: On jichou, Vice Minister of Revenue and revenue judge Cui Cong was made Works Minister and revenue judge.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Cui Cong took Works while keeping revenue.

sentences.zh: 以山南西道節度使崔從為尚書左丞；

translations.literal: Shannan West military commissioner Cui Cong was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Cui Cong became left vice director;

sentences.zh: 以秘書監許季同為華州刺史，充潼關防禦、鎮國軍使。

translations.literal: Secretariat Supervisor Xu Jitong was made Hua prefect and Tong Pass defense and Zhenguo army commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Jitong went to Hua and Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，昭義劉悟奏，自將兵次臨城。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Zhaoyi Liu Wu memorialized that he personally led troops encamped at Lincheng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Liu Wu camped at Lincheng with his army.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午朔，裴度奏破賊於會星鎮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiawu new moon — Pei Du memorialized breaking rebels at Huixing post.
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh month opened with Pei Du's victory at Huixing.

sentences.zh: 硃克融兵大寇定州，節度使陳楚出師拒戰，破賊二萬。

translations.literal: Zhu Kerong's troops greatly raided Dingzhou; military commissioner Chen Chu went out to resist and broke twenty thousand rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Chu repelled a twenty-thousand-man raid on Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，徐州崔群奏，遣節度副使王智興率師赴行營。

translations.literal: On yisi, Xuzhou's Cui Qun memorialized dispatching deputy commissioner Wang Zhixing with troops to the field camp.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Cui Qun sent Wang Zhixing to the front.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以司農卿裴武為鎮州行營供軍使。

translations.literal: On wushen, Minister of Agriculture Pei Wu was made Zhenzhou field army supply commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Pei Wu was named supply commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上御宣政殿，試製科舉人。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the Emperor attended Xuanzheng Hall and tested decree-examination candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the emperor held the decree examination.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，淄青牙將馬延崟謀逆，節度使薛平覺其謀而誅之。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Ziqing guard officer Ma Yanling plotted rebellion; military commissioner Xue Ping detected the plot and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Xue Ping executed a mutinous Ziqing officer.

sentences.zh: 詔中書舍人白居易、繕部郎中陳岵、考功員外郎賈餗同考制策。

translations.literal: An edict named Secretariat Drafter Bai Juyi, Protocol Bureau Director Chen Hu, and Merit Bureau Outer Director Jia Su to grade the decree examination.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Juyi, Chen Hu, and Jia Su were named examiners.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子朔。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiazi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The twelfth month opened on jiazi.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以前容管經略使留後嚴公素為容州刺史、容管經略使。

translations.literal: On bingyin, former Rongguan pacification acting commissioner Yan Gongsu was made Rongzhou prefect and Rongguan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Yan Gongsu took Rongguan.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，貶諫議大夫李景儉為楚州刺史。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Remonstrating Doctor Li Jingjian was demoted to Chuzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Li Jingjian was exiled to Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，杜叔良之軍與賊戰於博野，為賊所敗，七千人陷賊，叔良僅免。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Du Shuliang's army fought rebels at Boye, was defeated by rebels, seven thousand men fell to the rebels, and Shuliang barely escaped.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Du Shuliang lost seven thousand men at Boye and barely escaped.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，敕諸道除上供外，留州留使錢內每貫割二百文以助軍用，賊平後仍舊。

translations.literal: On yihai, an edict: aside from tribute to the throne, within each circuit's retained funds two hundred cash per string were to be cut to aid military use; after rebels were pacified the old rule would resume.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai circuits were ordered to divert two hundred cash per string to the war effort.

sentences.zh: 定州陳楚破硃克融賊二萬於望都。

translations.literal: Dingzhou Chen Chu broke twenty thousand Zhu Kerong rebels at Wangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Chu routed twenty thousand rebels at Wangdu.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以鳳翔節度使李光顏為忠武軍節度使，代李遜，仍兼深、冀行營節度。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Fengxiang military commissioner Li Guangyan was made Zhongwu military commissioner, replacing Li Xun, and still concurrently Shen-Ji field commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Li Guangyan replaced Li Xun and kept the Shen-Ji command.

sentences.zh: 以李遜為鳳翔節度使。

translations.literal: Li Xun was made Fengxiang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xun went to Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 貶員外郎獨孤朗韶州刺史，起居舍人溫造朗州刺史，司勳員外郎李肇澧州刺史，刑部員外郎王鎰郢州刺史，坐與李景儉於史館同飲，景儉乘醉見宰相謾駡故也。

translations.literal: Outer Director Dugu Lang was demoted to Shaozhou prefect, Attendant on the Emperor Wen Zao to Langzhou prefect, Merit Bureau Outer Director Li Zhao to Lizhou prefect, and Punishments Bureau Outer Director Wang Yi to Yingzhou prefect — all for drinking with Li Jingjian in the History Office; Jingjian when drunk had seen the chief ministers and reviled them.
translations.idiomatic: Four officials were demoted for drinking with Li Jingjian when he insulted the chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 兵部郎中知制誥馮宿、庫部郎中知制誥楊嗣復各罰一季俸料，亦坐與景儉同飲，然先起，不貶官。

translations.literal: War Bureau Director and edict drafter Feng Su and Treasury Bureau Director and edict drafter Yang Sifu were each fined one season's salary — also for drinking with Jingjian, but they had left first and were not demoted.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Su and Yang Sifu were fined but not demoted for the same banquet.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，李光顏赴鎮，百僚餞于章敬寺。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Li Guangyan departed to his post; the hundred officials saw him off at Zhangjing Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the court farewelled Li Guangyan at Zhangjing Temple.

sentences.zh: 上御通化門臨送，賜玉帶名馬。

translations.literal: The Emperor went to Tonghua Gate to see him off and bestowed jade belt and famous horses.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor saw him off at Tonghua Gate with belt and horses.

sentences.zh: 仍敕神策副使楊承和充深、冀行營都監押。

translations.literal: He also ordered Divine Strategy deputy commissioner Yang Chenghe to serve as overall supervisor of the Shen-Ji field command.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Chenghe was named field supervisor.

sentences.zh: 壬午，出內庫錢五萬貫以助軍。

translations.literal: On renwu, fifty thousand strings from the inner treasury were issued to aid the army.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu fifty thousand strings were released for the war.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以幽州都知兵馬使硃克融檢校左散騎常侍，充幽州盧龍軍節度使，其拘囚張弘靖、殺害府僚之罪，一切釋放。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Youzhou director of military affairs Zhu Kerong was made acting Left Regular Cavalry Attendant and Youzhou Lulong military commissioner; his crimes of detaining Zhang Hongjing and killing prefectural staff were entirely released.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Zhu Kerong was pardoned and confirmed as Lulong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 時朝議以克融能保全弘靖，王廷湊殺害弘正，可赦燕而誅趙，故有是詔。

translations.literal: At the time court opinion held that because Kerong had preserved Hongjing while Wang Tingcou had killed Hongzheng, Yan could be pardoned and Zhao punished — hence this edict.
translations.idiomatic: Court opinion favored pardoning Zhu Kerong while punishing Wang Tingcou.

sentences.zh: 是歲，天下戶計二百三十七萬五千八百五，口一千五百七十六萬二千四百三十二，元不進戶軍州不在此內。

translations.literal: That year, empire-wide households totaled 2,375,805; persons 15,762,432; non-tributary military prefectures were not included.
translations.idiomatic: The census counted 2.38 million households and 15.76 million persons.

sentences.zh: 長慶二年二年春正月癸巳朔，以用兵罷元會。

translations.literal: Changqing 2 — In spring of Changqing 2, first month, guisi new moon; because of military use the New Year audience was cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: Changqing 2 opened with war canceling the New Year audience.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以夔州刺史王承弁為安南都護、本管經略招討使。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Kuizhou prefect Wang Chengbian was made Protector General of Annan and pacification and suppression commissioner of his circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Wang Chengbian took Annan.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，硃克融陷滄州弓高縣，賊攻下博，兼邀餉道車六百乘而去。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Zhu Kerong took Gonggao county of Cangzhou; rebels attacked Xiabo and also intercepted six hundred supply carts and departed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Zhu Kerong seized Gonggao and ambushed supply trains.

sentences.zh: 庚子，魏博兵自潰於南宮縣。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Weibo troops mutinied and dispersed at Nangong county.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Weibo's army collapsed at Nangong.

sentences.zh: 戊申，魏博牙將史憲誠奪師，田布伏劍而卒。

translations.literal: On wushen, Weibo guard officer Shi Xiancheng seized the army; Tian Bu fell on his sword and died.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Shi Xiancheng mutinied and Tian Bu killed himself.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以魏博中軍先鋒兵馬使史憲誠檢校工部尚書，兼魏州大都督府長史魏博節度使。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Weibo vanguard commander Shi Xiancheng was made acting Works Minister, concurrent Administrator of We prefecture metropolitan government, and Weibo military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Shi Xiancheng was installed at Weibo.

sentences.zh: 是日，大風霾。

translations.literal: That day, great wind and dust haze.
translations.idiomatic: That day a dust storm rose.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以德州刺史王日簡為滄州刺史，充橫海軍節度、滄德棣觀察等使，以代叔良。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Dezhou prefect Wang Rijian was made Cangzhou prefect, Henghai military commissioner, and Cang-De-Di observation commissioner, replacing Shuliang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Wang Rijian replaced Du Shuliang at Cangzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬子，貶叔良為歸州刺史，以獻計誅幽鎮無功，而兵敗喪所持旌節也。

translations.literal: On renzi, Shuliang was demoted to Guizhou prefect for offering plans to destroy You-Zhen without success and for defeat and loss of his command banners.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Du Shuliang was exiled for failure and losing his banners.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以工部尚書、判度支崔倰檢校禮部尚書，兼鳳翔尹，充鳳翔隴節度使。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Works Minister and revenue judge Cui Cong was made acting Minister of Rites, concurrent Fengxiang intendant, and Fengxiang-Long military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Cui Cong went to Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 以鴻臚卿、兼御史大夫張平叔判度支。

translations.literal: Grand Herald and concurrent Censor-in-Chief Zhang Pingshu judged revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Pingshu took charge of revenue.

sentences.zh: 復以弓高縣為景州。

translations.literal: Gonggao county was restored as Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Gonggao was re-established as Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 青州奏海凍二百里。

translations.literal: Qingzhou memorialized the sea frozen two hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Qingzhou reported two hundred li of frozen sea.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以前鳳翔節度使李遜為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On yimao, former Fengxiang military commissioner Li Xun was made Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Li Xun became punishment minister.

sentences.zh: 己未，刑部尚書李遜卒。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Minister of Punishments Li Xun died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Li Xun died.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以兗、沂、密觀察使曹華為節度使；

translations.literal: On gengzi, Yan-Qi-Mi observation commissioner Cao Hua was made military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Cao Hua received a military commission;

sentences.zh: 以天德軍防禦使李進誠兼靈州刺史，充朔方、靈、鹽定遠城等州節度使；

translations.literal: Tiande defense commissioner Li Jincheng was made concurrent Lingzhou prefect and Shuofang-Ling-Salt-Ding-Yuan city military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Li Jincheng took Shuofang;

sentences.zh: 以晉州刺史李岵為豐州刺史，充天德軍、豐州、東西受降城都防禦使。

translations.literal: Jinzhou prefect Li Gu was made Fengzhou prefect and Tiande-Feng-East-West Surrender City defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gu was posted to Tiande.

sentences.zh: 內出繒帛八萬匹以助軍。

translations.literal: Eighty thousand bolts of silk were issued from the inner palace to aid the army.
translations.idiomatic: The court released eighty thousand bolts of silk for the war.

sentences.zh: 權停嶺南、黔中今年選補。

translations.literal: Lingnan and Qianzhong selections for this year were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Civil appointments in Lingnan and Qianzhong were halted.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥朔。

translations.literal: Second month, guihai new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The second month opened on guihai.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔雪王廷湊，仍授鎮州大都督府長史、御史大夫，充成德軍節度、鎮冀深趙等州觀察等使。

translations.literal: On jiazi, an edict absolved Wang Tingcou and still appointed him Administrator of Zhenzhou metropolitan prefecture, Censor-in-Chief, Chengde military commissioner, and military commissioner of Zhen, Ji, Shen, and Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Wang Tingcou was pardoned and confirmed at Chengde.

sentences.zh: 三軍將士，待之如初。

translations.literal: The three armies' officers and soldiers were to be treated as before.
translations.idiomatic: His troops were to be treated as before.

sentences.zh: 仍令兵部侍郎韓愈往彼宣諭。

translations.literal: He was still to send Vice Minister of War Han Yu to proclaim comfort there.
translations.idiomatic: Han Yu was sent to announce the amnesty.

sentences.zh: 以前吉州刺史張弘靖為撫州刺史。

translations.literal: Former Jizhou prefect Zhang Hongjing was made Fuzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hongjing was named Fuzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 弘靖初貶官，尚在幽州，拘留半歲，克融授節，始得還，故有是命。

translations.literal: When Hongjing was first demoted he was still in Youzhou, detained half a year; when Kerong received his commission he was able to return — hence this order.
translations.idiomatic: Hongjing had been held in Youzhou until Zhu Kerong released him.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以前成德軍節度使牛元翼檢校工部尚書、襄州刺史，充山南東道節度觀察、臨漢監牧等使。

translations.literal: On bingyin, former Chengde military commissioner Niu Yuanyi was made acting Works Minister, Xiangzhou prefect, Shannan East observation, Linhan pasture, and other commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Niu Yuanyi left the north for Shannan East.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以考功郎中、知制誥李德裕為書舍人，依前翰林學士。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Merit Bureau Director and edict drafter Li Deyu was made Secretariat Drafter, continuing as Hanlin academician.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Li Deyu was promoted while keeping the Hanlin post.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以鄜坊節度使韓充為義成軍節度使，以代王承元。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Yan-Fang military commissioner Han Chong was made Yicheng military commissioner, replacing Wang Chengyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Han Chong replaced Wang Chengyuan at Yicheng.

sentences.zh: 以承元為鄜坊節度使。

translations.literal: Chengyuan was made Yan-Fang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chengyuan took Yan-Fang.

sentences.zh: 甲戌夜，火、木星相近。

translations.literal: On jiaxu night, Fire and Wood stars drew near each other.
translations.idiomatic: Mars and Jupiter converged on jiaxu night.

sentences.zh: 滄州節度使王日簡賜姓名李全略。

translations.literal: Cangzhou military commissioner Wang Rijian was granted the surname Li and name Quanlue.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Rijian was renamed Li Quanlue.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以正議大夫、守中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事、武騎尉、賜紫金魚袋崔植為刑部尚書，罷知政事。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Proper Counsel Grand Master, acting Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councillor, Martial Cavalry Commandant, granted gold-purple fish bag Cui Zhi was made Minister of Punishments and ceased governing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Cui Zhi left the council for Punishments.

sentences.zh: 以工部侍郎元稹守本官、同平章事。

translations.literal: Works Vice Minister Yuan Zhen kept his office and became Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zhen entered the council as works vice minister.

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士、中書舍人李德裕為御史中丞。

translations.literal: Hanlin academician and Secretariat Drafter Li Deyu was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Li Deyu became censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 司勳員外郎、知制誥李紳為中書舍人，依前翰林學士。

translations.literal: Merit Bureau Outer Director and edict drafter Li Shen was made Secretariat Drafter, continuing as Hanlin academician.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shen was promoted to drafter while keeping the Hanlin.

sentences.zh: 右庶子王仲周以奉使緩命，貶台州刺史。

translations.literal: Right Vice Heir Apparent Wang Zhongzhou was demoted to Taizhou prefect for dilatory mission conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhongzhou was exiled to Taizhou for slow dispatch.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以深、冀行營諸軍節度、忠武軍節度使李光顏為滄州刺史、橫海軍節度使，兼忠武軍節度、深冀行營並如故；

translations.literal: On guiwei, Shen-Ji field armies military commissioner and Zhongwu military commissioner Li Guangyan was made Cangzhou prefect and Henghai military commissioner, still concurrently Zhongwu military commissioner and Shen-Ji field command as before;
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Li Guangyan took Cangzhou while keeping Zhongwu and the field command;

sentences.zh: 以橫海軍節度使李全略為德州刺史、德棣等州節度。

translations.literal: Henghai military commissioner Li Quanlue was made Dezhou prefect and De-Di military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Quanlue went to De-Di.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以兵部郎中、知制誥馮宿檢校左庶子，充山南道節度副使，權知襄州軍府事，以牛元翼在深州重圍故也。

translations.literal: On bingxu, War Bureau Director and edict drafter Feng Su was made acting Left Vice Heir Apparent, Shannan circuit deputy military commissioner, and acting manager of Xiangzhou military government — because Niu Yuanyi was in heavy siege at Shenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Feng Su was sent to manage Xiangzhou while Niu Yuanyi was besieged.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以河東節度使、司空、兼門下侍郎、平章事裴度守司徒、平章事，充東都留守，判東都尚書省事、都畿汝防禦使、太微宮等使；

translations.literal: On dinghai, Hedong military commissioner, Minister of Works, concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery, and Grand Councillor Pei Du kept Minister of Works and Grand Council seat, was made Eastern Capital intendant, judged Eastern Capital Secretariat affairs, Capital Region and Ru defense commissioner, and Taiwei Palace commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Pei Du was posted to the Eastern Capital while keeping council rank;

sentences.zh: 以前靈武節度使李聽為太原尹、北都留守、河東節度使。

translations.literal: former Lingwu military commissioner Li Ting was made Taiyuan intendant, Northern Capital intendant, and Hedong military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ting took Hedong.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰朔，詔曰：「武班之中，淹滯頗久。

translations.literal: Third month, renchen new moon — an edict said: "Among martial ranks, stagnation has been considerable.
translations.idiomatic: The third month opened with an edict on promoting martial officers:

sentences.zh: 又諸薦送大將，或隨節度使歸朝。

translations.literal: Also, recommended field generals sometimes follow military commissioners back to court.
translations.idiomatic: "Field generals often return with their commissioners.

sentences.zh: 自今已後，宜令神策六軍軍使及南衙常參武官，各具歷任送中書門下，素立大功及有才器者，量加獎擢。

translations.literal: From now on, the six Divine Strategy army commissioners and southern palace regular martial officials should each submit their service records to the Secretariat; those who have long established great merit or possess talent and capacity should be promoted as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Martial officers should submit records for merit-based promotion.

sentences.zh: 常參官依月限改轉，諸道軍府帶監察已上官者，限三周年即與改轉。

translations.literal: Regular officials transfer by monthly limits; military government officials of surveillance rank and above in circuits are to transfer after three annual terms.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit officers of surveillance rank would rotate every three years.

sentences.zh: 軍士死王事者，三周年內不得停衣糧。

translations.literal: Soldiers who died for the throne — within three annual terms clothing and grain must not be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Families of the war dead would keep rations three years.

sentences.zh: 先于留州留使錢內每貫割二百文助軍，今後不用抽取。

translations.literal: Formerly two hundred cash per string were cut from retained funds to aid the army — hereafter no such extraction."
translations.idiomatic: The wartime levy on circuit funds was ended." Thus ended the edict.

sentences.zh: 」上於馭軍之道，未得其要，常雲宜姑息其臣。

translations.literal: The Emperor on the way of controlling armies had not grasped the essentials and often said ministers should be indulged.
translations.idiomatic: Muzong never mastered army discipline and indulged his commanders.

sentences.zh: 故即位之初，傾府庫頒賞之，長行所獲，人至巨萬，非時賜與，不可勝紀。

translations.literal: Hence at the beginning of his reign he emptied the treasury in distributions; long-service recipients reached tens of thousands, and untimely gifts were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: He emptied the treasury on rewards that made soldiers rich and arrogant.

sentences.zh: 故軍旅益驕，法令益弛，戰則不克，國祚日危。

translations.literal: Thus the armies grew more arrogant, laws more lax; in battle they could not win, and the dynasty daily grew perilous.
translations.idiomatic: Discipline collapsed, battles were lost, and the throne grew daily weaker.

sentences.zh: 洎頒此詔，方鎮多以大將文符鬻之富賈，曲為論奏，以取朝秩者，疊委於中書矣。

translations.literal: When this edict was issued, regional commanders often sold great generals' written warrants to wealthy merchants, who twisted memorials to obtain court rank — they piled up at the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commanders then sold promotions to merchants who flooded the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 名臣扼腕，無如之何，癸巳，以兵部尚書蕭俛為太子少保，以前山南東道節度使李逢吉為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Famous ministers wrung their hands without remedy. On guisi, Minister of War Xiao Mian was made Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince; former Shannan East military commissioner Li Fengji was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Powerful ministers could only watch. On guisi Xiao Mian and Li Fengji were reassigned.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，左驍衛上將軍張奉國卒。

translations.literal: On renyin, Left Valiant Cavalry General Zhang Fengguo died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Zhang Fengguo died.

sentences.zh: 以鴻臚卿、判度支張平叔為戶部侍郎唷職。

translations.literal: Grand Herald and revenue judge Zhang Pingshu was made Vice Minister of Revenue on stipend.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Pingshu became vice revenue minister.

sentences.zh: 平叔以曲承恩顧，上疏請官自賣鹽，可以富國強兵，陳利害十八條。

translations.literal: Pingshu, currying favor, memorialized asking that the state itself sell salt to enrich the country and strengthen the army, setting forth eighteen points of benefit and harm.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Pingshu proposed state salt monopoly in eighteen articles.

sentences.zh: 詔下其疏，令公卿詳議。

translations.literal: The edict forwarded his memorial for public discussion by the chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered debate on his plan.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人韋處厚隨條詰難，固言不可，事遂不行。

translations.literal: Secretariat Drafter Wei Chuhou rebutted item by item and firmly said it could not be done — the matter then ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Chuhou refuted it and the plan died.

sentences.zh: 硃克融、王廷湊合兵攻深州，不解。

translations.literal: Zhu Kerong and Wang Tingcou combined armies to attack Shenzhou without lifting the siege.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Kerong and Wang Tingcou kept Shenzhou under siege.

sentences.zh: 裴度與書諭之，克融還鎮，廷湊攻城亦緩，乃並加檢校工部尚書。

translations.literal: Pei Du wrote to instruct them; Kerong returned to his post and Tingcou also slowed the siege — both were then made acting Works Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Du's letters eased the siege and both rebels received acting Works rank.

sentences.zh: 戊申，裴度來朝，對於麟德殿，伏奏龍墀，因敘河北用兵，嗚咽流涕，上改容慰勞之。

translations.literal: On wushen, Pei Du came to court, answered at Linde Hall, prostrated on the dragon steps, and as he narrated Hebei military use wept aloud; the Emperor changed expression and comforted him.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Pei Du wept at court over Hebei and won the emperor's comfort.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以新授東都留守裴度為揚州大都督府長史，充淮南節度使。

translations.literal: On renzi, newly appointed Eastern Capital intendant Pei Du was made Administrator of Yangzhou metropolitan prefecture and Huainan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Pei Du was sent to Huainan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，徐州節度使崔群為其副使王智興所逐，智興自專軍務。

translations.literal: On guichou, Xuzhou military commissioner Cui Qun was driven out by his deputy Wang Zhixing, who monopolized military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Wang Zhixing ousted Cui Qun at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以右僕射韓皋為左僕射，以前淮南節度使李夷簡為右僕射。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Right Vice Director Han Gao was made Left Vice Director; former Huainan military commissioner Li Yijian was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Han Gao and Li Yijian were promoted as vice directors.

sentences.zh: 前東都留守李絳復拜舊官。

translations.literal: Former Eastern Capital intendant Li Jiang was again appointed to his old office.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiang returned to the Eastern Capital post.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，守司徒裴度正衙受冊訖，謁太廟，赴尚書省上，宰臣百僚皆送。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Acting Minister of Works Pei Du received investiture at regular audience, visited the Imperial Ancestral Temple, went up at the Secretariat — chief ministers and the hundred officials all escorted him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Pei Du's investiture drew the full court in procession.

sentences.zh: 丁己，以左丞崔從檢校禮部尚書、鄜州刺史、鄜坊節度使，以代王承元。

translations.literal: On dingji, Left Vice Director Cui Cong was made acting Minister of Rites, Yan prefect, and Yan-Fang military commissioner, replacing Wang Chengyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingji Cui Cong replaced Wang Chengyuan at Yan-Fang.

sentences.zh: 以承元為鳳翔、隴節度使。

translations.literal: Chengyuan was made Fengxiang-Long military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chengyuan went to Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 戊午，司徒裴度復入中書知政事。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Minister of Works Pei Du again entered the Secretariat to manage governance.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Pei Du rejoined the council.

sentences.zh: 以中書侍郎、平章事王播檢校右僕射，兼揚州大都督府長史，充淮南節度使，依前兼諸道鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councillor Wang Bo was made acting Right Vice Director, concurrent Administrator of Yangzhou metropolitan prefecture, Huainan military commissioner, still concurrently Salt and Iron Transport Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bo took Huainan while keeping Salt and Iron.

sentences.zh: 以鳳翔節茺使崔俛為河南尹。

translations.literal: Fengxiang military commissioner Cui Cong was made Henan intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Cong became Henan intendant.

sentences.zh: 牛元翼率十餘騎突圍出深州來朝，深州大將臧平等一百八十人皆為王廷湊所殺。

translations.literal: Niu Yuanyi led more than ten horsemen to break siege and come to court from Shenzhou; Shenzhou great general Zang Ping and one hundred eighty men were all killed by Wang Tingcou.
translations.idiomatic: Niu Yuanyi escaped Shenzhou; Wang Tingcou slaughtered Zang Ping and 180 officers left behind.

sentences.zh: 己未，以武寧軍節度副使王智興檢校工部尚書，兼徐州刺史，充武甯軍節度使。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Wuning army deputy military commissioner Wang Zhixing was made acting Works Minister, concurrent Xuzhou prefect, and Wuning military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Wang Zhixing was confirmed at Wuning.

sentences.zh: 以德、棣節度使李全略復為滄州節度使，仍合滄、景、德、棣為一鎮。

translations.literal: De-Di military commissioner Li Quanlue was again made Cangzhou military commissioner; Cang, Jing, De, and Di were again united as one command.
translations.idiomatic: Li Quanlue reunited the Cang-De-Di command.

sentences.zh: 李光顏還鎮許州。

translations.literal: Li Guangyan returned to his post at Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangyan returned to Xu.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛酉朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinyou new moon — the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth month opened with a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 甲子，左僕射韓皋赴省上，中使賜酒饌，宰臣百僚送，一如近式。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Left Vice Director Han Gao went up at the Secretariat; palace envoys bestowed wine and viands; chief ministers and the hundred officials escorted him — all as recent precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Han Gao's installation followed recent ceremonial precedent.

sentences.zh: 雲陽縣角抵力人張蒞負羽林官騎康憲錢。

translations.literal: Yunyang county wrestler Zhang Li owed Palace Guard cavalry officer Kang Xian money.
translations.idiomatic: A Yunyang wrestler owed a guardsman money.

sentences.zh: 憲往徵之。

translations.literal: Xian went to collect it.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Xian came to collect the debt.

sentences.zh: 蒞乘醉打憲將殞，憲男買德年十四，持木鐘擊蒞首破，三日而卒。

translations.literal: Li, drunk, struck Xian nearly to death; Xian's son Maide, fourteen years old, took a wooden mallet and broke Li's head — he died three days later.
translations.idiomatic: Drunk, Zhang Li beat Xian nearly dead; Xian's fourteen-year-old son Maide killed Li with a mallet.

sentences.zh: 刑部奏覆，敕曰：「買德尚在童年，能知子道。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Punishments submitted review; an edict said: "Maide is still in childhood and knows a son's duty.
translations.idiomatic: Punishments reviewed the case; the edict said Maide was a child who knew filial duty:

sentences.zh: 雖殺人當死，為父可哀。

translations.literal: Though killing merits death, for his father it is pitiable.
translations.idiomatic: "killing deserved death, yet his motive for his father was pitiable.

sentences.zh: 若從沉命之科，恐失原情之意。

translations.literal: If the full death penalty is applied, I fear the meaning of leniency according to circumstance will be lost.
translations.idiomatic: Full execution would ignore the circumstances.

sentences.zh: 可減死罪一等。

translations.literal: The death sentence may be reduced one degree."
translations.idiomatic: Reduce the sentence one degree." Thus ended the edict.

sentences.zh: 」忻州刺史李寰守博野，王廷湊玫之不下。

translations.literal: Xinzhou prefect Li Huan held Boye; Wang Tingcou attacked but could not take it.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huan held Boye against Wang Tingcou's assault.

sentences.zh: 其李寰所領兵宜割屬右神策，以寰為軍使，仍以忻州軍為名。

translations.literal: The troops Li Huan commanded should be detached to the Right Divine Strategy Army; Huan should be made army commissioner, and the Xinzhou army should retain the Xinzhou name.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huan's troops were transferred to the Right Divine Strategy under his command.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，桂管觀察使杜式方卒。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Guiguan observation commissioner Du Shifang died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Du Shifang died.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以武甯軍節度使崔群為秘書監，分司東都。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Wuning military commissioner Cui Qun was made Secretariat Supervisor, assigned to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Cui Qun was sidelined to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 翰林侍講學士韋處厚、路隨進所撰《六經法言》二十卷，賜錦彩二百匹、銀器二百事，處厚改中書舍人，隨改諫議大夫，並賜金紫。

translations.literal: Hanlin Lecturing Academicians Wei Chuhou and Lu Sui presented their compiled Classic Exegesis in twenty scrolls; they were granted two hundred bolts of brocade and two hundred silver vessels; Chuhou was made Secretariat Drafter, Sui Remonstrating Doctor — both granted gold-purple.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Chuhou and Lu Sui presented Classic Exegesis and were richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以秘書監嚴譽為桂管觀察使。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Secretariat Supervisor Yan Yu was made Guiguan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Yan Yu took Guiguan.

sentences.zh: 是夜，東北有流星，光彩燭地，殷殷有聲，擊天市垣，至郎位滅。

translations.literal: That night, in the northeast a meteor, its light illuminating the ground, with deep rumbling sound, struck the Celestial Market Enclosure wall, reaching Lang position and extinguishing.
translations.idiomatic: That night a meteor thundered into the Celestial Market wall.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯朔。

translations.literal: Fifth month, xinmao new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth month opened on xinmao.

sentences.zh: 以德州刺史李景儉為諫議大夫。

translations.literal: Dezhou prefect Li Jingjian was made Remonstrating Doctor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jingjian was restored to remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，太子少傅嚴綬卒。

translations.literal: On guichou, Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince Yan Shou died.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Yan Shou died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，幽州硃克融上表進馬萬匹、羊十萬口，先請其價賞軍。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Youzhou Zhu Kerong submitted a memorial presenting ten thousand horses and one hundred thousand sheep, first requesting their price to reward the army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Zhu Kerong offered horses and sheep for cash to pay his troops.

sentences.zh: 隴山有異獸如猴，腰尾皆長，色青赤而猛鷙，見蕃人則躍而食之，遇漢人則否。

translations.literal: In Long Mountains there was a strange beast like a monkey, with long waist and tail, blue-red in color and fierce; seeing Tibetans it leaped and ate them, but not Han people.
translations.idiomatic: Long Mountains reported a beast that ate Tibetans but spared Han travelers.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申朔。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengshen new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth month opened on gengshen.

sentences.zh: 甲子，司徒、平章事裴度守尚書右僕射，工部侍郎、平章事元稹為同州刺史史。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Minister of Works and Grand Councillor Pei Du kept Right Vice Director; Works Vice Minister and Grand Councillor Yuan Zhen was made Tongzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Pei Du kept the vice directorship while Yuan Zhen was sent to Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 以正議大夫、守兵部尚書、輕車都尉李逢吉為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On yichou, Proper Counsel Grand Master, acting Minister of War, Light Chariot Commandant Li Fengji was made Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Li Fengji joined the council.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，大風震電，墜太廟鴟吻，霹御史台樹。

translations.literal: On yichou, great wind, thunder, and lightning — the owl-tail of the Imperial Ancestral Temple fell, and the Censorate tree was struck by lightning.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou a storm damaged the ancestral temple and the Censorate tree.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以易州刺史柳公濟為定州刺史、義武節度使。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Yizhou prefect Liu Gongji was made Dingzhou prefect and Yiwu military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Liu Gongji took Yiwu.

sentences.zh: 壬申，諫官論責裴度太重，元稹太輕，乃追稹制書，削長春宮使。

translations.literal: On renshen, remonstrating officials criticized that Pei Du's punishment was too heavy and Yuan Zhen's too light — Yuan Zhen's appointment edict was then pursued, and his Changchun Palace commissioner post was cut.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen remonstrators forced a rollback of Yuan Zhen's promotion.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以前右僕射李夷簡為太子少保，分司東都。

translations.literal: On wuyin, former Right Vice Director Li Yijian was made Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince, assigned to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Li Yijian was retired to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 戊子，復置邕管，以安南副使崔結為邕管經略使。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Yongguan was restored; Annan deputy commissioner Cui Jie was made Yongguan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Yongguan was restored under Cui Jie.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己丑朔。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jichou new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh month opened on jichou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，宋王結薨，廢朝。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Prince of Song Jie died; court audience was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Prince Jie died and mourning closed court.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，汴州軍亂，逐節度使李願，立牙將李翽為留後。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Bianzhou troops mutinied, drove out military commissioner Li Yuan, and installed guard officer Li Si as acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Bianzhou mutineers installed Li Si.

sentences.zh: 好畤縣山水漂溺居人三百家。

translations.literal: In Hao county mountains and waters flooded and drowned three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Floods drowned three hundred households in Hao county.

sentences.zh: 陳、許、蔡等州水。

translations.literal: Chen, Xu, and Cai circuits had flood water.
translations.idiomatic: Chen, Xu, and Cai suffered floods.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，出中書舍人白居易為杭州刺史。

translations.literal: On renyin, Secretariat Drafter Bai Juyi was sent out as Hangzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Bai Juyi was posted to Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔南北省五品已上官議討李翽。

translations.literal: On yisi, an edict ordered civil officials of fifth rank and above in north and south offices to discuss suppressing Li Si.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the court ordered officials to plan against Li Si.

sentences.zh: 丙午，貶李願為隨州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Li Yuan was demoted to Suizhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Li Yuan was demoted.

sentences.zh: 以鄭、滑節度使韓充為汴州刺史、宣武軍節蓄使、汴宋亳潁觀察等使，鄭、滑如故；

translations.literal: Zheng-Hua military commissioner Han Chong was made Bianzhou prefect, Xuanyi army military commissioner, and Bian-Song-Bo-Ying observation commissioner; Zheng-Hua as before;
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Han Chong was sent to Bianzhou with Xuanyi command;

sentences.zh: 以宣武軍節度押衙李祐為右金吾衛將軍。

translations.literal: Xuanyi army military commissioner guard officer Li You was made Right Golden Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: Li You was honored at court.

sentences.zh: 丁未，內出綾絹五十萬匹付度支，以供軍用。

translations.literal: On dingwei, five hundred thousand bolts of silk were issued from the inner palace to the revenue office for military use.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei five hundred thousand bolts of silk were released for the war.

sentences.zh: 陳、許水災，賑粟五萬石。

translations.literal: Chen and Xu flood disaster — fifty thousand shi of relief grain.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty thousand shi of grain relieved Chen and Xu.

sentences.zh: 己酉，中使楊瑞昌使鎮州。

translations.literal: On jiyou, palace envoy Yang Ruichang was sent to Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Yang Ruichang was sent to Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 王廷湊奏：「奉詔取牛元翼家族，請至秋末發遣。

translations.literal: Wang Tingcou memorialized: "Obeying the edict to take Niu Yuanyi's family — request to send them out only by late autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Tingcou asked to delay sending Niu Yuanyi's family until autumn.

sentences.zh: 其田弘正骸骨，尋訪不知所在。

translations.literal: As for Tian Hongzheng's remains, search has not found where they are."
translations.idiomatic: He claimed Tian Hongzheng's body could not be found."

sentences.zh: 」辛亥，以贈司徒、忠烈公李悽子源為諫議大夫，賜緋魚袋。

translations.literal: On xinhai, posthumous Loyal and Martyr Duke Li Yuan's son Yuan was made Remonstrating Doctor and granted crimson fish bag.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Li Yuan's son was honored at court.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，敕：「員外郎知刺誥二年後轉郎中，又二年後轉前行郎中，又一年即正除；

translations.literal: On yimao, an edict: "Outer Directors knowing drafting duties, after two years become Directors; after two more years become senior Directors; after one more year receive regular appointment;
translations.idiomatic: On yimao an edict fixed promotion timelines for drafting officers:

sentences.zh: 諫議大夫知同前郎中；

translations.literal: Remonstrating Doctors follow the same as Directors above;
translations.idiomatic: remonstrators followed the same ladder;

sentences.zh: 給事中並翰林學士別宣知者，不在此限。

translations.literal: Attendants on the Emperor and Hanlin academicians with separate edict appointment are not within this limit."
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin appointees were excepted." Thus ended the edict.

sentences.zh: 」以前義武軍節度使陳楚為東都留守、判尚書省事、東畿汝防禦使。

translations.literal: Former Yiwu military commissioner Chen Chu was made Eastern Capital intendant, judging Secretariat affairs, and Eastern Capital and Ru defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Chu was named Eastern Capital intendant.

sentences.zh: 本朝故事，東都留守罕用武臣，今用楚，以李翽擾汴、宋故也。

translations.literal: This dynasty's precedent rarely used martial ministers as Eastern Capital intendant; Chu was used now because Li Si disturbed Bian and Song.
translations.idiomatic: A martial intendant was chosen because Bianzhou was in revolt.

sentences.zh: 八月己未朔，以絳州刺史崔弘禮為河南尹，兼東畿防禦副使。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiwei new moon — Jiangzhou prefect Cui Hongli was made Henan intendant and Eastern Capital defense deputy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth month opened with Cui Hongli named Henan intendant.

sentences.zh: 給事中韋穎以弘禮望輕，封還詔書，上遣中使諭之，乃下。

translations.literal: Attendant on the Emperor Wei Ying, because Hongli's standing was light, returned the edict sealed; the Emperor sent a palace envoy to instruct him — then it was issued.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Ying blocked the edict until the emperor overruled him.

sentences.zh: 詔陳、許李光顏將兵收汴州。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Chen-Xu Li Guangyan to lead troops to recover Bianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangyan was ordered to retake Bianzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以左僕射韓皋為東都留守、判尚書省事、東畿汝防禦使。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Left Vice Director Han Gao was made Eastern Capital intendant, judging Secretariat affairs, and Eastern Capital and Ru defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Han Gao took the Eastern Capital post.

sentences.zh: 以東都留守陳楚為河陽懷節度使。

translations.literal: Eastern Capital intendant Chen Chu was made Heyang-Huai military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Chu went to Heyang.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，韓充奏今月六日發軍入汴州界，營於千塔。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Han Chong memorialized that on the sixth of this month he had sent the army into Bianzhou territory and encamped at Qian Pagoda.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Han Chong reported his army entering Bian territory.

sentences.zh: 丙子，汴州監軍姚文壽與兵馬使李質同謀斬李翽及其党薛志忠、秦鄰等。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Bianzhou supervising commissioner Yao Wenshou and military commissioner Li Zhi together plotted and beheaded Li Si and his partisans Xue Zhizhong, Qin Lin, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Bianzhou loyalists beheaded Li Si and his partisans.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，韓充入汴州。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Han Chong entered Bianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Han Chong entered Bianzhou.

sentences.zh: 以前東都留守李絳為華州刺史，充潼關防禦、鎮國軍等使。

translations.literal: Former Eastern Capital intendant Li Jiang was made Hua prefect and Tong Pass defense and Zhenguo army commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiang was posted to Hua and Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 浙東處州大水，溺居民。

translations.literal: In Zhedong, Chuzhou had great flood water drowning residents.
translations.idiomatic: Chuzhou flood drowned Zhedong residents.

sentences.zh: 以兗、海沂密節度使曹華為滑州刺史，充義成軍節度、鄭滑潁等州觀察等使；

translations.literal: Yan-Hai-Qi-Mi military commissioner Cao Hua was made Hua prefect and Yicheng military commissioner and Zheng-Hua-Ying observation commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Cao Hua took Yicheng;

sentences.zh: 以宋州刺史高承簡為兗州刺史、兗海沂密等州節度使；

translations.literal: Songzhou prefect Gao Chengjian was made Yan prefect and Yan-Hai-Qi-Mi military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Gao Chengjian took Yan;

sentences.zh: 以汴州防城兵馬使李質為右金吾衛將軍。

translations.literal: Bianzhou city-defense military commissioner Li Zhi was made Right Golden Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhi was honored at court.

sentences.zh: 潁州棣鄭、滑觀察使。

translations.literal: Yingzhou Di-Zheng-Hua observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was named Ying observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 鹽鐵轉運使王播進《開潁口圖》。

translations.literal: Salt and Iron Transport Commissioner Wang Bo presented the Diagram of Opening the Ying Mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bo presented a canal plan for the Ying mouth.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子朔，浙西大將王國清謀叛，觀察使竇易直討平之，同惡二百餘人並誅之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wuzi new moon — Zhexi great general Wang Guoqing plotted rebellion; observation commissioner Dou Yizhi suppressed it; more than two hundred accomplices were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: The ninth month opened with Dou Yizhi crushing a Zhexi mutiny.

sentences.zh: 韓充送李翽男道源、道樞、道瀹等三人，斬於西市；

translations.literal: Han Chong sent Li Si's sons Daoyuan, Daoshu, and Daoyue — the three were beheaded at the Western Market;
translations.idiomatic: Han Chong sent Li Si's sons to be beheaded at the Western Market;

sentences.zh: 翽妻馬氏、小男道本、女汴娘配于掖庭。

translations.literal: Si's wife Lady Ma, young son Daoben, and daughter Bianniang were assigned to the Palace Women.
translations.idiomatic: Li Si's family was sent to the palace women.

sentences.zh: 壬子，太子少師李夷簡卒贈太子太保。

translations.literal: On renzi, Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince Li Yijian died and was posthumously made Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Li Yijian died and was posthumously honored.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以前河陽節度使郭釗為河中尹，兼河中、絳、隰等州節度使。

translations.literal: On guimao, former Heyang military commissioner Guo Zhao was made Hedong intendant and Hedong, Jiang, and Xi military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Guo Zhao took Hedong.

sentences.zh: 禦使中丞李德裕為潤州刺史、兼御史大夫、浙江西道都團練觀察處置等使，以代竇易直。

translations.literal: Supervising Censor-in-Chief Li Deyu was made Runzhou prefect, concurrent Censor-in-Chief, and Zhexi regrouped-defense observation and disposition commissioner, replacing Dou Yizhi.
translations.idiomatic: Li Deyu replaced Dou Yizhi in Zhexi.

sentences.zh: 以易直為吏部會議郎。

translations.literal: Yizhi was made Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Yizhi became vice personnel minister.

sentences.zh: 加晉州刺史李寰為晉、慈等州都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: Jinzhou prefect Li Huan was promoted to Jin-Ci regrouped-defense observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huan received an observation commission.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，敕團練防禦州置判官一員，其副使推巡並停。

translations.literal: On yisi, an edict: regrouped-defense prefectures were to have one administrative aide; deputy commissioners for patrol were all stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi regrouped-defense prefectures were streamlined.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以吏部侍郎柳公綽為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Vice Minister of Personnel Liu Gongchuo was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Liu Gongchuo became censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 先有詔廣芙蓉苑南面，居人廬舍墳墓並移之，群情駭擾。

translations.literal: Earlier an edict had expanded the south face of Furong Garden; commoners' lodges and graves were all to be moved — public sentiment was alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: An order to expand Furong Garden had uprooted commoners.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，降敕罷之。

translations.literal: On guichou, a lowered edict cancelled it.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the expansion was cancelled.

sentences.zh: 德州軍亂，害剌史王稷，盡剽其家財奴僕。

translations.literal: Dezhou troops mutinied, killed prefect Wang Ji, and plundered all his household wealth and slaves.
translations.idiomatic: Dezhou mutineers killed Wang Ji and looted his household.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以萬州刺史李元喜為安南都護。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Wanzhou prefect Li Yuanxi was made Protector General of Annan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Li Yuanxi took Annan.

sentences.zh: 陰山府沙陀突厥兵馬使硃耶執宜來朝貢，賜官誥、錦彩、銀器。

translations.literal: Yinshan-fu Shatuo Turk military commissioner Zhuye Zhixin came to court with tribute; official patent, brocade, and silver vessels were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Shatuo leader Zhuye Zhixin came to court with gifts.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午朔。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, wuwu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The tenth month opened on wuwu.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，前河中晉、絳、慈、隰等州節度使、開府儀同三司、守司徒、中書令、河中尹、上柱國、許國公韓弘可守司徒、兼中書令。

translations.literal: On renxu, former Hedong Jin-Jiang-Ci-Xi military commissioner, Palace Grandee, acting Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councillor, Hedong intendant, Upper Pillar, Duke of Xu Han Hong was confirmed as acting Minister of Works and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Han Hong was confirmed in high council rank.

sentences.zh: 甲子夜，月掩牽牛中星。

translations.literal: On jiazi night, the moon occulted the middle star of the Ox Herd.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi night the moon eclipsed the Ox Herd.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，興元節度使以色列重胤來朝，移授天平軍節度使。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Xingyuan military commissioner Wu Chongyin came to court and was transferred to Tianping military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Wu Chongyin was transferred to Tianping.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以工部侍郎鄭權為工部尚書，以前華州刺史許季同為工部侍郎。

translations.literal: On jimao, Works Vice Minister Zheng Quan was made Works Minister; former Hua Vice Minister Xu Jitong was made Works Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Zheng Quan and Xu Jitong were reassigned at Works.

sentences.zh: 是日，上由復道幸咸陽，止於善因佛寺，施僧錢百萬，咸陽令絹百匹。

translations.literal: That day, the Emperor by the covered way went to Xianyang, stopping at Shanyin Buddhist temple, bestowing one million cash on monks and one hundred bolts of silk on the Xianyang magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: That day the emperor visited Xianyang and lavished gifts on monks and officials.

sentences.zh: 閏十月戊子朔，入回紇使金吾大將軍胡證、副使光祿卿李憲、婚禮使衛尉卿李銳、副使宗正少卿李子鴻等，送太和公主自蕃中回。

translations.literal: Intercalary tenth month, wuzi new moon — Uyghur envoys Golden Guard Grand General Hu Zheng, deputy envoy Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Li Xian, marriage envoy Chamberlain Li Rui, deputy envoy Court of Imperial Sacrifices Vice Director Li Zihong, and others escorted Princess Taihe back from the barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: The intercalary month brought Princess Taihe home from the Uyghurs.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以吏部尚書鄭絪為太子少傅；

translations.literal: On gengyin, Minister of Personnel Zheng Yin was made Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince;
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Zheng Yin became crown prince tutor;

sentences.zh: 乙太常卿趙宗儒為吏部尚書；

translations.literal: Grand Master of the Palace Zhao Zongru was made Minister of Personnel;
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zongru took Personnel;

sentences.zh: 韋綬為興元尹，充山南西道節度使。

translations.literal: Wei Shou was made Xingyuan intendant and Shannan West military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Shou went to Shannan West.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，右驍衛大將軍韓公武卒，廢朝。

translations.literal: On renchen, Right Valiant Cavalry General Han Gongwu died; court audience was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Han Gongwu died and mourning closed court.

sentences.zh: 以戶部尚書楊于陵為太常卿。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue Yang Yuling was made Grand Herald.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yuling became grand herald.

sentences.zh: 丙申，回紇可汗遣使獻國信四床、女口六人、葛祿口四人。

translations.literal: On bingshen, the Uyghur qaghan sent envoys presenting four state-letter beds, six female attendants, and four Karluk attendants.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the Uyghur qaghan sent lavish gifts.

sentences.zh: 己亥，敕翰林侍講學士諫議大夫路隨、中書舍人韋處厚，兼充史館修撰《憲宗實錄》，仍更日入史館。

translations.literal: On jihai, an edict: Hanlin Lecturing Academician and Remonstrating Doctor Lu Sui and Secretariat Drafter Wei Chuhou were additionally made History Office compilers of the Veritable Record of Xianzong, still entering the History Office on alternate days.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Lu Sui and Wei Chuhou were named to compile Xianzong's Veritable Record.

sentences.zh: 《實錄》未成，且許不入內署，仍放朝參。

translations.literal: Because the Veritable Record was not yet complete, they were for the time being not to enter the inner drafting office, yet were released from court audience.
translations.idiomatic: Until the record was done they need not attend inner drafting or regular audience.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔：「江淮諸州旱損多，所在米價不免踴貴，眷言疲困，須議優矜。

translations.literal: On jiayin, an edict: "Many Jiang-Huai prefectures suffered drought damage; local rice prices could not but soar — thinking on the weary and distressed, favor must be discussed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict on drought relief began:

sentences.zh: 宜委淮南、浙西東、宣歙、江西、福建等道觀察使，各于當道有水旱處，取常平義倉斛鬥，據時估減半價出糶，以惠貧民。

translations.literal: Huainan, western and eastern Zhexi, Xuanshe, Jiangxi, and Fujian observation commissioners should each in their circuits where flood or drought occurred take Ever-Normal Granary grain, sell at half the current price estimate to benefit the poor."
translations.idiomatic: "Southern observers should sell granary grain at half price where drought struck." Thus ended the edict.

sentences.zh: 」丙辰，以太子賓客令狐楚為陝、虢觀察使。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Crown Prince Guest Linghu Chu was made Shan-Guo observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Linghu Chu took Shan-Guo.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁巳朔。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, dingsi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh month opened on dingsi.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，尚書左丞庾承宣為陝、虢觀察使。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Geng Chengxuan was made Shan-Guo observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Geng Chengxuan took Shan-Guo.

sentences.zh: 令狐楚復為太子賓客，分司東都。

translations.literal: Linghu Chu again became Crown Prince Guest, assigned to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Linghu Chu was recalled to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 楚已至陝州視事一日，追改之。

translations.literal: Chu had reached Shanzhou and assumed duties one day — then was changed.
translations.idiomatic: He had served one day at Shanzhou before the reversal.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命景王率禁軍五百騎，侍從皇太后幸華清宮，又幸石甕寺。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Prince Jing was ordered to lead five hundred palace guard horsemen attending the Empress Dowager to Huaqing Palace, and also to Stone Urn Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Prince Jing escorted the empress dowager to Huaqing.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以前安南都護桂仲武為邕管經略使。

translations.literal: On xinwei, former Protector General of Annan Gui Zhongwu was made Yongguan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Gui Zhongwu took Yongguan.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上幸華清宮迎太后，巡狩於驪山下，即日馳還，太后翌日方還。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the Emperor went to Huaqing Palace to welcome the Empress Dowager, touring below Mount Li — that day he galloped back; the Empress Dowager returned only the next day.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the emperor rushed home from Huaqing before the empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 丙子，集王緗薨。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Prince of Ji Xiang died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Prince Xiang died.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上與內官擊鞠禁中，有內官欻然墜馬，如物所擊。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the Emperor and inner attendants played cuju in the forbidden quarters; an inner attendant suddenly fell from his horse as if struck by something.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen an inner attendant fell mysteriously during palace cuju.

sentences.zh: 上恐，罷鞠升殿，足不能履地，風眩就床。

translations.literal: The Emperor was afraid, stopped cuju and ascended the hall; his feet could not tread the ground; vertigo sent him to bed.
